news.Title: Can OnStar and Super Cruise Drive GM's Digital Revenue Growth?
news.Content:
General Motors GM is increasingly looking beyond vehicle sales to build a recurring software and services business. Its OnStar connected services platform and Super Cruise hands-free driving technology are emerging as key contributors to this strategy. A growing subscriber base, wider technology adoption and subscription renewals could help GM increase revenue per vehicle and build a more predictable, margin-accretive revenue stream.

OnStar and Super Cruise Strengthen GM's Digital Revenue Base

GM's digital business is gaining scale, supported by rising OnStar subscriptions and growing adoption of Super Cruise. OnStar ended the third quarter of 2026 with $6.8 billion in deferred revenue, up about 40% year over year, while recognized revenue exceeded $800 million, up 15%. The company expects to add approximately 1 million subscribers in 2026, taking its global subscriber base close to 13 million. Management also expects software and services deferred revenue to approach $7.5 billion by year-end, with realized revenue exceeding $3 billion.

Super Cruise is another growth driver. The technology ended 2025 with more than 620,000 subscribers, up approximately 80% year over year, and generated $234 million in revenue. GM expects Super Cruise revenue to approach $400 million in 2026 and its subscriber base to exceed 850,000 by year-end. In the third quarter, recognized revenue increased roughly 60%, while GM delivered nearly 83,000 Super Cruise-equipped vehicles, taking year-to-date deliveries above 243,000.

Importantly, the subscription attach rate after the initial three-year prepaid period remained at 30-40%, providing opportunities for continued recurring revenue. Super Cruise-equipped vehicles also travel more than 1 million cumulative hands-free miles daily, while nearly 70% of customers use the technology at least once a month.

GM is looking to build on this momentum through its next-generation 2027 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra light-duty pickups. Super Cruise will be standard on high-end trims and optional on most others. Management expects the technology's penetration across its full-size truck portfolio to increase four to five times in 2027.

The opportunity is also attracting Ford F and Tesla TSLA, which are expanding their own connected services and driver-assistance offerings. Ford reported more than 1.7 million active paid software subscriptions through September 2026, up more than 40% year over year. BlueCruise and connectivity were among the largest contributors to software services growth, while Ford and Lincoln customers accumulated nearly 14 million hours of hands-free highway driving.

Story Continues

Tesla, meanwhile, reported more than 1.7 million global paid Full Self-Driving (FSD) customers in the third quarter, with subscriptions accounting for 50% of the base for the first time. More than 75% of its North American deliveries included an FSD subscription sign-up at delivery, approximately 20% higher than in the previous quarter. FSD was also available in nine European Union countries, with more than 100,000 customers using the technology.

Despite the opportunity, GM must sustain subscriber additions and improve renewals after the initial prepaid period. The 30-40% Super Cruise attach rate indicates that converting existing users into paying subscribers remains an important challenge. Competition from peers could also influence pricing, adoption and customer retention. Nevertheless, GM's expanding OnStar subscriber base, rising Super Cruise revenue and broader availability across its truck portfolio position software and services as an increasingly important contributor to its long-term growth strategy.

On Sept. 22, 2026, Nebius introduced dynamic spot pricing for preemptible virtual machines (PVMs), allowing GPU compute prices to adjust automatically based on available capacity and real-time demand. The pricing mechanism offers customers greater flexibility and cost savings for non-critical workloads, including data processing, experimentation and short-term model fine-tuning.

On Sept. 10, 2026, Nebius launched its AI Builder Program to help developers build and scale AI systems using open models and independent infrastructure. The initiative provides access to credits, technical resources, educational courses, certifications, expert guidance and a developer community. It aims to help AI builders maintain greater control over their models, tools and technology stacks.

On Sept. 8, 2026, Nebius announced a partnership with Palantir to provide sovereign AI infrastructure to Palantir's commercial customers. Under the agreement, Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner and plans to integrate Nebius compute and inference capabilities within its enterprise environment following an integration period.

NBIS Stock Performance

Nebius shares have lost 30.4% over the past year, underperforming the Zacks Computer & Technology sector's decline of 10.6% and the Zacks Internet Software Services industry's growth of 1.1%. The S&P 500 Composite has declined 2.3% over the same time frame.

The company has also outpaced its peers, NVIDIA Corporation NVDA, CoreWeave, Inc. CRWV and Microsoft Corporation MSFT. Shares of MSFT have surged 28.6%, while CoreWeave and NVIDIA declined 59.5% and 14.9%, respectively, in the same period.

NBIS' Stretched Valuation

In comparison, NVDA, MSFT and CRWV trade at multiples of 19.64X, 8.38X and 4.24X, respectively.

What to Do With NBIS Stock Before Q3 Earnings?

Despite near-term profitability pressures from heavy infrastructure investments, Nebius' robust AI cloud demand, expanding capacity and favorable GPU pricing trends strengthen its growth prospects.

Investors can consider buying NBIS stock ahead of its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, supported by the likelihood of an earnings beat and strong long-term AI infrastructure growth opportunities.

news.Title: Google Escalates Nvidia Rivalry With Specialized Versions of AI Chips
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Alphabet Inc.'s Google ( GOOG ) is rolling out a broader array of artificial intelligence chips, aiming to capitalize on its rapid ascent as a challenger to Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) in a market worth hundreds of billions of dollars.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Nvidia Probe Into CEO's Affair Raises Troubling Questions for AI

Georgia State Race Reversed After Votes Surface on Memory Card

Several Senate Republicans Call for Delaying Leadership Election

CoreWeave Asks Texas Governor-Elect for Data Center Cooperation

Rubio Weighs Leaving Administration After GOP's Midterm Loss

The company is introducing two new variations of its tensor processing units, or TPUs, custom-made semiconductors that help develop and run AI software. The latest chips will address the need for confidential computing and help models access a wider range of information when handling queries. More broadly, they're meant to serve an industry that's shifting toward the use of AI agents and confronting security challenges.

The rollout marks an acceleration in product development for Google's chip unit. The business once released a new AI processor every two years. This year, it put out two at the same time. And the latest variations, due to be announced Monday, will add additional flavors to that pair of chips.

The four TPU offerings will optimize different needs, Google chip chief Amin Vahdat said in an interview. "This really follows the thesis that we have here at Google, which is that the future is going to be about specialization, and the upsides for specialization continue to be significant."

Google is staking its claim at a tumultuous time for the AI chip industry. Concerns about a potential slowdown in infrastructure spending have roiled tech stocks, and US midterm elections that swept Democrats into power have raised fresh doubts about data center projects. But the demand for AI processors from Nvidia remains larger than it can satisfy, and that's left room for Google and other contenders to build a sizable business.

The new TPU 8tx and 8i Max variations aren't completely new silicon designs — rather, they're reconfigured to take on tasks that customers have been requesting, Vahdat said.

The 8tx is aimed at handling secure, confidential work for customers like government agencies and companies in regulated industries. The system works with chips from Advanced Micro Devices Inc., part of a collaboration between the two companies.

The 8i Max, meanwhile, is meant to run AI applications that require long-context windows — the amount of data an AI system can consider in a single request. That's necessary for things like drug discovery and math but is also important for coding applications, Vahdat said.

Story Continues

TPUs compete in a market dominated by Nvidia's graphics processing units, or GPUs. Google set out to develop the technology more than a decade ago, alongside Broadcom Inc., which helped with design and coordinating production. The initial idea was to more efficiently handle the search giant's burgeoning computing needs. It then realized the potential of TPUs for doing AI work and has now begun selling them outside of its cloud-computing operation.

Google's new life as a chip seller is proving lucrative. By 2028, TPU sales will top $135 billion, including related software and hardware, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. That's up from an estimated $12 billion this year, and it doesn't include sales from clients using the chips through Google Cloud.

TPUs have netted some high-profile clients, including Apple Inc., Meta Platforms Inc. and Oracle Corp. And offering specialized versions of the chips should help Google make further progress, Vahdat said. The variations will be available next year, he said.

"We could build a single chip that tries to address the whole market, or by building specialized versions of the chips, we actually can deliver much more value," he said.

Even Nvidia, which has historically promoted its GPUs as a product for all AI tasks, is starting to offer more specialized chip systems. That includes offering its own central processing units, or CPUs, a category pioneered by Intel Corp. Those processors don't handle the heavy-duty data crunching needed to create artificial intelligence models, but they're useful for managing AI agents.

Nvidia also is offering chips more focused on the inference stage of AI — where already-trained AI models carry out tasks — using technology it acquired from startup Groq.

Google's 8tx pairs with a CPU from AMD, a rival to both Nvidia and Intel. The technology allows data to be encrypted at the chip level, making it more secure. Normally, the information has to be unlocked in memory while a computer processes it, Vahdat said. The 8i Max puts two TPU chips in a single package to deliver more computing power and memory.

Part of the appeal of TPUs is their price for performance, said Mandeep Singh, an analyst at Bloomberg Intelligence. They cost about 30% less than Nvidia's GPUs but do a competitive job in terms of throughput — the amount of data that can be processed over a given time.

The approach appeals to a variety of clients, including users in finance and other fields. Google announced during its earnings report last month that Jump Trading is a TPU customer.

That company has spent several years trying out the chips before signing a larger contract with Google about a year ago, Jump Trading Chief Technology Officer Alex Davies said in an interview.

The trading firm has thousands of TPUs, which it uses to train AI models for things like trading research. Jump still mainly uses Nvidia for training but a "vocal minority" of employees really like TPUs for their tasks, Davies said.

TPUs work very well for a subset of tasks, he said. There's a benefit to using different kinds of chips to address challenges, Davies said. "It's actually attractive to have some problems being done differently," he said. "You learn stuff."

For the areas where TPUs are as good as or better than Nvidia chips, they also offer the benefit of being more power-efficient, which lowers the cost, he said.

Last month, Oracle said it had signed a deal to let its cloud customers use TPUs for the first time starting next year. Oracle cloud customers previously had a choice of AI chips from Nvidia and AMD.

"We partnered with Google because customers need more choice as AI workloads become more demanding," Karan Batta, a senior vice president overseeing Oracle's cloud infrastructure, said in a statement. "This partnership expands our ability to help customers build and run AI on the infrastructure that best fits their needs."

Anthropic PBC, maker of the Claude chatbot and other services, is another TPU customer. It has an option to purchase as much as $150 billion worth of the chips between 2028 and 2031, according to a recent regulatory filing. And OpenAI is planning to purchase TPUs as well, Bloomberg News has reported.

Google's own status as an AI software developer has helped bolster the chip operation. TPU developers have relied on early access to Google's latest Gemini models to improve things like power efficiency and catch bugs. That's critical in semiconductor design, where flaws can cost billions of dollars and erase months of work. AI is making those pitfalls less likely, Vahdat said.

But Google faces other challenges, including newcomers to the market. One startup co-founded by two former TPU engineers, called Tenspresso, is focusing its first chip on long-context window inference — the same area targeted by the 8i Max. But that product is at least a year away from design completion, Bloomberg reported last week.

OpenAI and Anthropic also are working on in-house chip efforts — staffed with TPU veterans — providing another source of future competition.

There's also the risk of a slowdown in AI infrastructure spending. The backlash against data centers threatens to shrink the $1.4 trillion that technology companies were expected to spend by roughly 5% to 7% in 2027, according to Bloomberg's Singh. That includes spending on chips, networking equipment, land and other materials for data center construction.

And Google's TPU profit margins are less robust than what Nvidia generates, according to Singh.

Like the rest of the chip and AI infrastructure space, Google is also facing shortages of key components like memory and manufacturing capacity. That's made it hard to meet demand. Every TPU that Google has available is already contracted to a customer, the company said in its earnings report.

Vahdat's team is trying to diversify its supply sources where it can. That even means looking beyond Broadcom, which arranges manufacturing for TPUs. In recent months, Google signed a deal with Broadcom rival Marvell Technology Inc. that includes some TPU work — though the announcement was light on specifics. There have also been reports that MediaTek Inc. is doing work for Google's TPU business.

Vahdat declined to comment on either company's role in the TPU business.

William Tong, an analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence, said it's likely that Google is working out longer-term agreements "to get this supply set and prevent more bottlenecks."

news.Title: Nvidia, Palantir, and Tesla Are Sending Shockwaves Through Wall Street With This $53 Billion Warning
news.Content:
For the better part of the last four years, no catalyst has played a bigger role in lifting the broader market than the evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) . Whether it's AI-accelerating hardware or AI applications, an IDC report pegs this cumulative addressable opportunity at $22.5 trillion from 2025 to 2031.

Few companies have taken the AI bull by the horns more than Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR), and Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA).

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Nvidia's graphics processing units (GPUs) are the infrastructure backbone of AI-accelerated data centers. None of its competitors are particularly close to matching the compute capabilities of its multiple generations of GPUs.

Meanwhile, AI-driven software-as-a-service provider Palantir is a veritable blueprint for deploying AI applications. The company's Gotham platform assists the U.S. military with planning and overseeing missions.

Electric-vehicle maker Tesla is also an AI applications maven. AI is integral to the success of its full self-driving software and its Optimus humanoid robots.

Image source: Getty Images.

While this trio has thrived amid the AI infrastructure build-out, the individuals who know these companies best are sending all the wrong signals to Wall Street .

Nvidia's, Palantir's, and Tesla's insiders are shaking Wall Street to its core

Though stock market analysts spend day after day studying the same industry and the companies that define it, no one understands Nvidia, Palantir, and Tesla better than their respective insiders.

An "insider" is a high-ranking executive, board member, or beneficial owner of at least 10% of a company's outstanding shares who may possess nonpublic information. Anytime an insider buys or sells their company's stock, they're legally required to file Form 4 with regulators within two business days. This allows investors to track whether a company's insiders have been buying or selling.

In the case of this powerhouse AI trio, insiders have been undeniable net sellers of their company's stock over the trailing five years:

Nvidia : $6,860,636,476 in net selling

Palantir : $6,371,606,538 in net selling

Tesla : $39,479,555,646 in net selling

Collectively, insiders at these companies have sold more than $52.7 billion more of their own company's stock than they've purchased since early November 2021.

Story Continues

There is, however, an asterisk that should accompany the above data. Since high-ranking executives and board members are often compensated in stock or options, they're required to sell some of their holdings to cover their federal and/or state tax liability. In other words, insider selling isn't automatically a bad thing -- especially if it's for tax purposes.

What's equally unnerving, from an investment standpoint, is the relative lack of insider buying. With the exception of one sizable purchase totaling nearly $1 billion by Tesla CEO Elon Musk, insider buying has been practically nonexistent in this trio over the trailing five years:

Nvidia : $250,000 in insider buying

Palantir : $7,837,856 in insider buying

Tesla : $1,000,984,274 in insider buying

If insiders aren't buying, historical precedent might explain why.

For more than 30 years, every game-changing innovation has navigated an early-innings bubble-bursting event. This includes the internet, 3D printing, blockchain technology, and the metaverse.

The reason these bubbles form and subsequently burst is that investors consistently overestimate the pace of optimization for game-changing technologies. While AI solutions have been welcomed with open arms, we're likely several years away from businesses optimizing these solutions to boost sales and profits. In other words, the door is wide open for a potential AI bubble-bursting event.

news.Title: Not AMD. Not Intel. This Is the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chip Stock Nvidia Should Fear Most.
news.Content:
Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) has dominated the semiconductor market throughout the artificial intelligence (AI) revolutions. Its graphics processing units (GPUs) are essential infrastructure for companies developing generative AI models.

Naturally, investors are focusing on competitors like Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) and Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), both of which make their own GPU and CPU architectures. However, I think Nvidia's biggest competitive threat could come from an entirely different direction.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

AI hyperscalers are developing their own processors, known as application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), to reduce costs and optimize performance for particular workloads.

With major customers including Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG), Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META), OpenAI, and Anthropic, Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) is emerging as a formidable competitor for future AI infrastructure spending. Here's why smart investors should pay attention.

Broadcom is helping Nvidia's biggest customers make their own chips

Nvidia's GPUs are useful because they can handle a wide variety of accelerated computing tasks. However, that flexibility isn't always necessary. Custom ASICs are designed for specific applications, potentially offering better performance per dollar of compute and lower energy consumption for certain workloads.

Broadcom is helping design these specialized processors while also supplying networking technology that connects clusters of chips inside data centers. Let's consider its expanding roster of AI chip customers.

Alphabet is working with Broadcom on its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), including the seventh-generation Ironwood processor. These chips support Google Cloud and are being deployed for Anthropic. Broadcom expects Anthropic to deploy 5 gigawatts of eighth-generation TPU v8i capacity in 2027, followed by an additional 10 gigawatts in 2028.

Meanwhile, Meta is collaborating with Broadcom on its Meta Training and Inference Accelerator (MTIA) processors. Their partnership extends through 2029, with visibility into 3 gigawatts of deployments through 2028.

Last October, Broadcom and OpenAI announced plans to deploy 5 gigawatts of XPUs by the end of 2028. OpenAI's first processor, code-named Jalapeño, is expected to support 1.3 gigawatts of deployments in 2027.

Story Continues

These relationships show how Broadcom isn't simply competing for isolated semiconductor contracts. The company is becoming an important partner for world's largest AI developers.

Broadcom's AI revenue could become a problem for Nvidia

Broadcom's financial results suggest demand for custom silicon is accelerating. During the company's fiscal third quarter (period ended Aug. 2), AI semiconductor revenue more than tripled year over year to $16.7 billion. Custom chips accounted for roughly 73% of that total.

Management guided for AI semiconductor revenue to reach $21.7 billion in the fourth quarter. The longer-term projections are even more impressive. Broadcom expects AI semiconductor revenue to reach roughly $115 billion in fiscal 2027 and potentially double to $230 billion in fiscal 2028.

This is where it gets challenging for Nvidia. As AI adoption accelerates, developers are increasingly focused on inference, the process of using trained models to generate responses and perform tasks.

Specialized processors can be attractive for repetitive inference workloads because they are designed around specific requirements. As a result, custom silicon could become a growing market that competes with Nvidia's GPUs in data center budgets.

Semiconductor sell-off: Buy the dip in Broadcom stock

The investment thesis here becomes compelling once you consider Broadcom's valuation. As of this writing (Nov. 6), Broadcom stock trades around $294, representing a 39% decline from its all-time high. Broadcom stock now trades at a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple of 15, its cheapest level since the AI revolution began.

AVGO PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

I think Broadcom's valuation profile looks reasonable given management's robust expectations for AI semiconductor growth in fiscal 2027 and 2028. Moreover, the company's business extends beyond custom processors. Broadcom also specializes in Ethernet switching, optical connectivity, and other networking technologies that are essential for connecting AI accelerators.

On a deeper level, this means Broadcom can actually benefit from expanding AI infrastructure even when customers continue purchasing Nvidia GPUs. This means Nvidia doesn't actually need to lose its dominance for Broadcom to become a winner in the AI chip market. Rather, Broadcom simply needs more hyperscalers to decide that designing their own silicon makes economic sense.

Based on its customer relationships and revenue outlook, that transition appears to be gathering momentum. For long-term investors looking for alternatives to Nvidia, Broadcom deserves serious consideration.

news.Title: 台股急殺引發槓桿斷鏈！景碩、富喬、聯亞爆違約交割 總額逾1.17億元
news.Content:
證交所與櫃買中心今(9)日發布個股違約交割資訊，兩市合計違約交割總金額高達 1 億 1,712 萬 2,600 元。本次爆出違約的標的均為近期交投熱門股，包含 ABF 載板廠景碩(3189-TW)，以及上櫃的玻纖布廠富喬(1815-TW)與光通訊廠聯亞(3081-TW)。

依現行台股「T+2」交割制度推算，三檔違約案件的實際交易日均落在11月5日。當天台股大盤與櫃買指數雙雙遭遇獲利了結賣壓與避險拋售潮，盤中呈現劇烈急殺，導致部分運用高槓桿當沖或融資買進的投資人陷入無法補足交割款項的困局，進而引爆鉅額違約風暴。

其中，景碩爆出2,908萬6,100元的違約交割金額，通報券商包括元大新中、國泰敦南、永豐潮州、群益丹鳳、玉山城中及國泰敦二等六家分公司。景碩在11月5日開盤後即遭遇電子族群沉重賣壓，股價自前一日收盤價822元一路被摜壓，盤中甚至落入跌停板，終場重挫超過8%收在753元，短線劇烈波動讓當日進場追高的資金殺得措手不及。

違約金額最高者為富喬，單一檔個股違約交割金額即高達6,952萬6,500元，包括企銀台南、統一士林、中國信託、新光、聯邦三重、國泰敦二、元大台中、台新新莊等高達18家證券分公司通報。

富喬11月5日當天交投異常熱絡，盤中高低價差劇烈震盪，隨著大盤急殺，賣壓湧現並直奔跌停價121.5元鎖死。由於通報分公司遍及全台，顯示當日大量內資與散戶開高槓桿搶進，卻因打入跌停無法平倉而出局。

聯亞則爆出1,851萬元的違約金額，通報集中於美好證券楊梅分公司。由於聯亞股價高達千元以上，一張股票動輒近200萬元，高槓桿操作的風險相對極高。11月5日聯亞走勢疲弱，自開盤後一路走低，終場重挫210元並收在當日最低價1,890元，單日巨大跌幅可能導致當沖買盤資金斷鏈。

金管會與證交所提醒，投資人若發生違約交割，除會被註記極嚴重的個人信用瑕疵、影響日後向金融機構申請各項貸款與開戶外，券商依法最高可收取成交金額7%的違約金，並追究相關民刑事責任，投資人操作時務必審慎評估資金槓桿與自身承擔風險能力。

news.Title: 黃仁勳外遇砸出甜甜價？外媒點名「快入手這1檔」
news.Content: 財經中心／綜合報導 輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳震撼承認婚外情，甚至捲入國安與間諜疑雲，讓全球科技界與資本市場掀起巨浪！然而在市場因新聞震盪、投資人焦慮觀望之際，外媒卻指出這正是看清核心價值的絕佳時機，最新分析報告震撼指出，相較於運算設備、應用軟體或能源供應等繁雜選項，晶圓代工龍頭台積電（TSMC）能直接穿透所有噪音，堪稱是這波 AI 狂潮中「幾乎打包票必勝的終極贏家」！報告大讚台積電憑藉市占率 72.5% 的無敵產能霸權與領先技術，加上 AI 業務年複合成長率看破 50%，搭配當前僅 23 倍預估本益比的折價甜甜價，絕對是全球投資人不可錯過的長期爆發標的。 晶圓代工龍頭台積電（TSMC）。（資料照／民視新聞網） 根據《 The Motley Fool 》報導，台積電作為全球最核心的邏輯晶片製造巨頭，幾乎包辦了所有主要晶片設計公司的代工訂單。包括輝達（Nvidia）、超微（AMD）以及博通（Broadcom）等巨頭在內，全都死心塌地仰賴台積電的晶圓代工服務。 最致命的關鍵在於，全球根本沒有任何一家晶圓代工廠能提供足夠產能作為台積電的替代方案。數據顯示，光是第二季台積電就一舉吞下全球晶圓代工高達 72.5% 的營收市占率！憑藉這股恐怖的龐大產能優勢與業界頂尖的生產良率，競爭對手想在短時間內趕上、甚至搶走台積電的核心主要客戶，難度堪比登天。 外媒指出，全球根本沒有任何一家晶圓代工廠能提供足夠產能作為台積電的替代方案。（資料照／民視新聞網） 報導指出，只要全球企業對運算能力的需求持續爆炸性成長，台積電就能源源不絕地接到巨量 AI 晶片訂單。台積電先前已公開預估，2024 年至 2029 年間，AI 晶片業務營收的年複合成長率（CAGR）將高達 50% 中段至高段的水準；台積電董事長暨總經理魏哲家更在第三季法說會上自信直言，這項成長數據「可能還會更高」，顯示對未來市況抱持無比樂觀的態度。

news.Title: Google makes a $300 move Pixel buyers should know
news.Content:
Your phone is getting older. Its battery doesn't last as long as it used to, and your children keep asking for a better camera for family pictures.

Replacing it sounds straightforward, until you look at the price.

Nowadays, a high-end smartphone can cost more than $1,000, making upgrades a significant financial burden for families already dealing with growing daily expenses.

Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google is offering some relief.

The Pixel 11 Pro, previously priced at $1,099, is now just $799, thanks to a $300 price reduction from the tech giant.

The basic Pixel 11 is $200 less expensive than the larger Pixel 11 Pro XL, which offers an even greater $350 savings.

When compared to standard rates, the Pro discount could save a family $600 when upgrading two phones.

However, consumers must meet a crucial deadline. Just weeks before Black Friday, on Nov. 8, Google's offer expires.

Customers face a practical conundrum: Should they wait to see whether Christmas discounts increase, or buy now while the savings are still available?

Google cuts Pixel prices before Black Friday

Google's early holiday promotion covers several devices in its latest smartphone lineup.

According to Google's official store offers page, the discounts began Oct. 30 and are scheduled to expire Nov. 8 at 11:59 p.m. PST.

The current promotional prices are:

Pixel 11: $699, down from $899

Pixel 11 Pro: $799, down from $1,099

Pixel 11 Pro XL: $949, down from $1,299

Subject to availability, the savings are available on qualified unlocked phones bought from Google's U.S. store.

9to5Google reported on Oct. 30 that Amazon and Best Buy were offering matching discounts when the promotion began.

Since the phone just came out a few months ago, the Pro discount stands out. Google's high-end phone is now just $100 more than the entry-level Pixel 11, which is $799.

Customers may see the two models differently as a result of the minor price difference.

The typical phone could be sufficient for someone who is mostly interested in making calls, texting, surfing, and sometimes taking photographs. However, parents who often take pictures of their kids, holidays, or school functions may find the Pro's more sophisticated camera system worthwhile.

Why the $300 Pixel discount comes with a catch

The real question to consider is whether a discounted premium phone makes financial sense for a household.

Google's Pixel 11 Pro costs $799 during the promotion, but purchasing two devices still means spending $1,598 before taxes or optional accessories. Even after deducting the $600 combined reduction, it's a substantial cost.

Story Continues

Consumers should also be aware that the launch costs of Google's most recent smartphones were greater than those of their predecessors.

Wired reported on Nov. 5 that the Pixel 11 series launched with prices $100 above the previous generation amid pressure from an AI-driven memory shortage.

Thus, the new reduction comes after a previous price increase.

There are limitations to Google's offer as well. The offer often cannot be combined with other discount codes or package deals, and customers must be U.S. citizens with U.S. delivery addresses.

However, eligible trade-ins are an exception, with their value varying based on the gadget and its condition. For families looking to combine several advertised savings, that is important.

Carrier campaigns that advertise significant savings may require consumers to continue service for months or years, and a trade-in estimate does not guarantee cash.

Before making a purchase, buyers should determine the whole cost.

Is the Pixel 11 Pro actually worth buying?

With several features, Google's Pixel 11 Pro may be attractive to homes looking to replace outdated electronics.

A 6.3-inch display, Google's Tensor G6 processor, and triple cameras are among the phone's official specs.

The Pro model's 48-megapixel telephoto camera and other photographic capabilities enhance zoom and low-light images. These capabilities could be more significant than the gadget's artificial intelligence features, especially for parents who use their phones to record family activities.

More Google:

Google is making a change in November that might catch Gemini users off guard

Google set to challenge Meta Muse in the Agentic AI race

Google just disclosed something troubling about its AI

In addition, Google is highlighting Gemini Intelligence, which may aid with task assistance, information organization, and cross-application compatibility.

Customers shouldn't assume that every AI function is exclusive to the Pro, however.

The basic Pixel 11 also uses the Tensor G6 CPU and has many of Google's latest software features. The cameras, display quality, and other functions that a customer really uses might be the practical difference.

How long the phone will be functional is another factor to take into account. Google guarantees the Pixel 11 Pro will get operating system and security upgrades for seven years.

For someone who intends to retain the gadget for several years instead of replacing it every year, it can make the purchase more appealing.

Longer software support does not, however, allay worries about battery aging, unintentional harm, or evolving individual demands.

Google's discount creates a bigger question for investors

The ad serves as a reminder to Alphabet investors of the company's ongoing efforts to compete with Apple and Samsung in the market for high-end handsets.

Google wants to showcase its artificial intelligence technology, Gemini, on Pixel smartphones.

If Google sells more compatible devices, customers may become more familiar with its software, services, and broader ecosystem. But all else being equal, discounts also result in lower revenue per device, compared to full-price sales.

Investors are unable to assess whether the campaign increases Google's profitability without knowing unit sales, manufacturing costs, and promotional expenditures.

Alphabet's smartphone division also constitutes a much smaller portion of the corporation than its cloud and advertising divisions.

Although a successful Pixel campaign may help Google's consumer hardware strategy, it wouldn't significantly alter Alphabet's financial prospects on its own.

Whether Google can convince users to stay in its ecosystem is the more significant long-term issue.

Should you buy a Pixel now or wait?

Google's existing reductions provide a tangible way for customers whose phones are malfunctioning to lower the price of an upgrade.

The $300 discount on the Pixel 11 Pro is significant, especially for customers who want its cutting-edge cameras and high-end capabilities.

However, homes with working phones should think about whether they need to upgrade right now.

Google hasn't promised better Black Friday pricing, but it's possible more bargains could come later. Before making a purchase, buyers should also check store pricing and trade-in values, especially because advertised deals could have various conditions.

The option with the biggest savings isn't always the greatest choice for families buying many phones. It's the one that offers what customers need at a cost they can afford.

Google has made its premium Pixel more affordable, but the $300 discount doesn't automatically make upgrading the smartest financial decision.

With the Nov. 8 deadline approaching, consumers must decide whether the savings justify the purchase or whether keeping their existing phones is worth more.

news.Title: 輝達盤前股價跌近5%！董事會調查添變數 黃仁勳去留受關注
news.Content:
據外媒報導，輝達(NVDA-US)周一(9日)美股盤前下跌近5%，董事會針對執行長黃仁勳疑遭外國情報活動鎖定一事展開獨立調查，使其領導地位成為投資人關注焦點。在市場原已質疑AI資料中心投資前景之際，這項調查為輝達股價增添新的不確定性。

輝達盤前最新跌幅為4.8%，稍早在法蘭克福交易時段一度重挫逾6%。《路透》引述LSEG Datastream數據指出，若以當時跌幅估算，相較上周五收盤，輝達市值恐減少約2,700億美元。

這波賣壓出現在輝達周日宣布調查之後。此前媒體報導，黃仁勳與遭美方指為中國情報人員的黃樂(Huang Le，音譯，又名Alice Huang)關係密切。黃仁勳已向員工承認對婚姻不忠，但未交代關係細節，並承諾配合調查。中國外交部則於周一否認相關間諜指控。

對投資人而言，市場關注的是調查是否影響黃仁勳繼續領導輝達。Yorkville Ives & Co.資深董事總經理Dan Ives向《CNBC》表示，事件對黃仁勳與公司構成重大變局，但並未改變輝達在AI晶片領域領先中國兩至三年的判斷。他認為，更換黃仁勳的說法並不切實際，然而董事會既已啟動調查，結果仍難預料，因而帶來龐大不確定性。

Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston也認為，黃仁勳不太可能遭到撤換。他指出，市場正對資料中心建設前景抱持疑慮，調查消息對股價無疑雪上加霜；但若投資人真的認為黃仁勳將下台，賣壓恐怕會遠比目前猛烈。

市場也在評估事件是否波及其他晶片業者。Panmure Liberum投資策略師Joachim Klement認為，目前影響主要集中在輝達，但若黃仁勳的職位受到威脅，公司可能縮減對亞洲或美國其他企業的支持，衝擊才可能向外擴散。分析師另提醒，若調查拖長，可能延後輝達的投資決策或產品推出時程。

不過，亞洲主要供應商周一仍隨科技股反彈。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)台股上漲6.5%，三星電子(005930-KS)與SK海力士(000660-KS)(SKHY-US)韓股分別上漲2.9%及4.7%。美股晶片業者盤前則偏弱，英特爾(INTC-US)、邁威爾(MRVL-US)、高通(QCOM-US)與安謀(ARM-US)均跌逾1%。

NH投資證券分析師Ryu Young-ho指出，超微(AMD-US)等競爭對手短期可能獲得更多關注，但輝達產品難以取代，預料將限制實際衝擊。南韓政府也表示，預期已簽約的輝達GPU交付不會受到影響。

黃仁勳同時獲得部分政商人士聲援。美國總統川普肯定其對美國的貢獻，特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克則認同紅杉資本合夥人Shaun Maguire所稱，黃仁勳對美國AI領導地位不可取代。投資人Bill Ackman的態度較為審慎，認為若事件超出婚外情範圍、涉及國家安全，就會構成真正的問題。

輝達預定11月17日公布第三季財報。在調查結果尚未明朗之際，營運表現與公司對後續影響的說明，將成為市場接下來的觀察重點。

news.Title: Is Apple the Best Mag-7 Stock Now? ETFs in Focus
news.Content:
Apple AAPL has been the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock this year, gaining more than 27%. In comparison, Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF MAGS is up only 2.7% (at the time of writing). Microsoft Corp. MSFT is up 13.3%, Meta META is off 7%, Alphabet GOOGL is down 10.7%, NVIDIA NVDA is off 3.8% and Tesla TSLA has plunged about 21.5%.

Apple's golden days are likely to brighten further as Democrats win the midterm elections – an outcome viewed as a potential catalyst for the anti-AI trade.

Why Does AI Trade Fall Out of Favor?

The AI trade, which has powered much of Wall Street's bull-market rally, has been under pressure for quite some time. Concerns about generating adequate returns relative to the massive investments being made in AI, rising interest rate worries and the adverse impact of rogue AI agents on cybersecurity have kept AI investing under pressure over the past month.

Now, the space is likely to face another challenge following the Democrats' strong performance in the 2026 midterm elections. With concerns mounting over data center construction, energy consumption and regulatory hurdles, investors may want to consider diversifying into other sectors.

The Nasdaq Composite dropped 5.5% on Nov. 5, 2026, with the tech-heavy index closing in correction territory.

Why Is Apple a Good Tech Bet Now?

Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Apple has been a laggard in the AI race so far, which has turned into a boon for the iPhone maker. Along with several Wall Street analysts, we also believe that the tech giant's earnings drivers are more closely tied to iPhone sales mix, pricing and Services growth than to large-scale data center construction and AI model development. With resilient product demand, Apple is likely to benefit from the Democratic victory more than its peers.

Apple Tightens Employee AI Budgets Amid Rising Costs

Apple is reportedly tightening spending limits on employees' use of AI tools as part of a broader cost-control drive, even as it seeks to make AI a bigger part of its business operations, as mentioned on Yahoo Finance.

Interestingly, Apple's spending is increasing at the company level despite tighter employee-level budgets.

The company reported a 32% jump in research and development expenses in fiscal 2026, largely due to higher infrastructure and AI-related costs. Overall operating expenses climbed 22% to $75.5 billion, accounting for 16% of total net sales.

Lower AI Spending Limits for Engineers

Apple recently reduced the daily AI spending allowance for some engineers to $200 from $300, according to people familiar with the matter. The company is now considering further cuts for certain engineering teams, potentially bringing their daily limits down to just $100.

Story Continues

Other departments already operate under a $100 daily cap. However, Apple is also considering lowering the limit for some of these teams to as little as $25. Employees who need higher budgets for their work can request special approval from senior management.

The company has not publicly commented on the changes.

Lower Memory Chip Costs in the Cards?

According to Amit Daryanani, analyst at Evercore ISI, the reasons why the tech giant could emerge as a potential beneficiary of the election results are twofold. As quoted on Yahoo Finance, Daryanani considers Apple a relatively defensive investment amid uncertainty surrounding Washington's political and regulatory landscape.

A second potential tailwind for the company stems from memory chip costs. Apple faced higher memory costs in the September quarter and expects further increases in the December quarter. The company expects these pressures to continue beyond December. This presents another potential tailwind from the Democratic Party's midterm election victory.

Greater scrutiny of AI infrastructure investments could slow the pace of data center expansion, moderate demand for memory chips and potentially ease pricing pressures across the semiconductor supply chain (read: Is a Democratic Victory Good News for Apple? ETFs to Consider).

Balancing AI Adoption With Cost Control

Apple's move reflects a wider trend across the technology industry. Companies that initially encouraged employees to experiment freely with AI are now paying closer attention to the costs involved.

AI services charge users based on tokens, which measure the amount of text and other data processed by a model. More advanced models generally cost more, while demanding tasks such as writing and debugging code can quickly consume large numbers of tokens.

Apple employees have access to several AI platforms, including Anthropic's Claude, OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini. Some teams are now being encouraged to switch to cheaper models or use AI systems that run directly on their devices.

December Quarter Outlook

Apple's chief financial officer, Kevan Parekh, expects December-quarter revenues to increase 7-10% year over year, potentially making it the company's best quarter ever. Before the earnings release, the Zacks Consensus Estimate projected December-quarter sales growth of 5.73%.

The company expects Services revenue growth of 8-9%, while gross margin is projected at 45-46%, reflecting higher memory costs.

Decent Cash Position

Apple ended the quarter with $137 billion in cash and marketable securities against total debt of $80 billion. This is a key positive for Apple, particularly as some of its Magnificent Seven peers are experiencing cash flow pressures.

Why Buy Apple Shares With ETFs?

Against this backdrop, investors can gain exposure to Apple through a diversified ETF approach to minimize company-specific concentration risks. This approach allows investors to benefit from potential gains while limiting the impact of any sudden weakness in Apple shares caused by memory pricing, a potential decline in margins or weakness in China sales.

Meanwhile, investors can benefit from the recent political tailwind for Apple shares through ETFs. A solid holiday-quarter outlook and a strong cash position compared with other Big Tech peers are additional positives. With the AI trade currently faltering, Apple's limited AI infrastructure exposure could prove to be a boon at current levels.

news.Title: 反彈行情結束？ 台指期夜盤急殺700點 市場緊盯2大危機
news.Content:
台股9日上演強勢反攻，加權指數終場大漲1960.06點，創下史上第2大單日收盤漲點，收在41661.70點，漲幅達4.94%。然而，白天的多頭氣勢未能延續至夜盤，台指期一度重挫逾700點，顯示大盤急漲後仍面臨賣壓考驗，外資連續提款及輝達相關消息也成為市場關注焦點。

台股大漲近2000點 夜盤賣壓隨即湧現

台股9日在國安基金啟動第10次護盤、金管會祭出限空令，以及美股科技股止跌回升等因素帶動下，開高走強，盤中一度大漲2647.72點。權值股台積電上漲100元，收2235元，漲幅4.68%，帶動市場信心回溫。

不過，大盤急漲後，部分逢高調節賣壓出籠，台指期夜盤開低後跌勢擴大，盤中最低曾下探40715點，大跌763點，高低震盪585點。

值得注意的是，台股雖然單日強彈，但外資9日仍賣超900.56億元，已連續8個交易日賣超，累計金額達7957.15億元，逼近8000億元。

這也使得台股反彈與外資持續調節形成對比。即使國安基金護盤、金管會祭出限空令，且台積電等權值股帶動指數大幅回升，夜盤仍出現明顯賣壓，市場短線能否延續反彈，仍受到關注。

輝達夜盤下挫 市場關注半導體連動影響

另一項受到關注的變數來自輝達。輝達執行長黃仁勳坦承婚外情，相關對象另涉及大陸情報活動疑慮，輝達因此面臨個人醜聞及公司啟動獨立調查等消息衝擊。

輝達夜盤股價一度跌至175.32美元，暴跌11.32美元，跌幅達6.06%，市值蒸發2728.12億美元（約新台幣8.9５兆元）。

由於輝達與台灣及海外半導體企業具有密切合作關係，相關股價波動也引發市場對台股影響的關注。

台股白天大漲近2000點，夜盤卻一度重挫逾700點，加上外資持續大幅賣超，短線反彈能否延續，仍是市場接下來觀察的重點。

news.Title: Google warns millions of Gmail users could face new restrictions
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL , Financials ) said that planned internet safety laws in Australia might require its Google business to prohibit anyone under 18 from using Gmail and other online communication services.Under the Digital Duty of Care law, internet corporations would need to do more to stop harmful information or face fines of as much as A$109 million ($75.1 million).The proposal has cleared the House of Representatives in Australia but still requires Senate approval.Private chat, email and file storage may also be subject to age-verification rules, Google's head of YouTube policy in Australia and New Zealand, Rachel Lord, told MPs.She cautioned that compliance might include intrusive surveillance of private correspondence.Representatives from Meta Platforms, TikTok and Snap voiced similar worries about the bill's wide definition of harmful content.Tech firms warn regulatory uncertainty might force them to remove too much information to avoid penalties.The Australian government says comprehensive protections are needed to make the internet safer.The plan might provide regulatory issues for Alphabet and restrict access to services utilized by younger clients.But there has been no disclosure of any financial damage and the limits on Gmail are not yet in place.The next trigger is if the Australian Senate will adopt the measure and if legislators will change its age-verification standards.

news.Title: 外資賣超台股逾900億元　調節聯電、台積電
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年11月9日電）國安基金護盤助威，台股今天收漲1960.06點，改寫史上次高紀錄，但外資仍連8賣，今天賣超逾900億元，調節聯電逾4.7萬張居冠，其餘還有元大台灣50正2、友達、中鋼與台積電等，並布局主動式ETF。投顧分析，台股是否真正落底，仍須觀察美股走勢與外資後續動向。

台股今天開高反彈，終場上漲1960.06點，收在41661.7點，改寫史上次高收盤漲點，但42000點與5日線得而復失，成交值新台幣8379.29億元。

三大法人合計賣超945.26億元。其中，自營商賣超312.18億元，投信買超267.48億元，外資及陸資賣超900.56億元。

值得注意的是，外資連8個交易日賣超，累計賣超逾7957億元，投信連20日買超，自營商也連8個交易日賣超。

萬寶投顧執行長王榮旭向中央社記者表示，台股行情是否真正落底，仍須觀察美股走勢，目前費城半導體指數尚未站回5日線，也未突破上方壓力區。考量台股與美股連動性高，加上新台幣近期回貶，外資後續動向將是觀察重點。

根據公開資訊指出，外資賣超前10名中，聯電逾4.7萬張居冠、元大台灣50正2（00631L）逾4.3萬張居次，接續為元大台灣50 (0050) 、友達、中鋼、欣興、國泰費城半導體（00830）、台積電、日月光投控、景碩。其中賣超台積電逾8758張。

外資買超前10名中，依序為主動中信台灣收益（00406A）、主動統一台股增長（00981A）、主動統一升級50（00403A）、主動群益科技創新（00992A）、凱基台灣TOP50（009816）、華航、元大高股息 (0056) 、台玻、主動國泰動能高息（00400A）、宏碁。

news.Title: 台股重挫！卓榮泰急向賴清德報告　國安基金進場...金管會祭5措施
news.Content:
即時中心／廖予瑄報導

今（6）日台股盤中一度大跌近4,000點，終場重挫1,873點，收在39,701點；較本年度高點49,968點下跌10,267點，跌幅達20.55％。為穩定國內金融市場，行政院連續2日密集召開多場會議，研擬股市應變措施。對此，行政院發言人李慧芝表示，國安基金已決議授權執行秘書視市場情況動用資金，適時執行市場安定任務；金管會也宣布，自下週一（9日）起實施5項股市穩定措施。

台股重挫1873點　政院5大應變措施曝光

李慧芝指出，台股與美股及費城半導體指數連動密切，近期國際股市受到美國期中選舉後政經局勢影響，出現明顯波動。為因應國際情勢變化，行政院連續2日密集召開會議，並研擬多項應變措施。

李慧芝首先表示，行政院副院長鄭麗君昨（5）日上午邀集財政部、金管會、中央銀行等單位，針對近期股市走勢及可能採取的穩定措施進行研商，並要求相關部會加速完成應變準備，以適時因應市場變化。其次，國安基金今日下午收盤後也召開臨時會議，考量國際政經情勢仍存在高度不確定性，決議授權執行秘書視市場情況動用資金，適時執行市場安定任務。

金管會決議自下週一起實施5項股市穩定措施。（圖／民視新聞資料照）

李慧芝接著表示，金管會也決議自下週一（9日）起實施5項股市穩定措施，包括調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量、調高最低融券保證金成數等，希望維持證券市場秩序與穩定。另一方面，行政院長卓榮泰今（6）日下午4時也偕同鄭麗君及行政院秘書長張惇涵，率領財政部、金管會、主計總處及中央銀行等財經相關部會首長，向總統賴清德報告國際整體情勢分析及政府各項因應措施，確保相關部會掌握最新情勢，並協調後續政策方向。

李慧芝最後強調，鄭麗君晚間也將召集台美經貿工作小組會議，針對台美外交、經濟、金融市場，以及持續因應301調查等議題進行整體情勢分析，並確認各部會後續工作重點，強化跨部會協調及政策應變能力。

李慧芝表示，經財經相關部會評估，台灣經濟基本面穩健，科技產業持續成長，整體產業發展仍具支撐力。她重申，政府將持續密切掌握國際金融情勢及國內資本市場動態，除了國安基金已獲授權適時執行市場安定任務，各部會也將視市場變化採取必要措施，維護金融市場秩序及國內經濟穩定。

news.Title: 黃仁勳承認婚外情後 加密市場驚現910萬美元空單
news.Content:
根據外媒《TheStreet》記者報導，在半導體巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳公開承認婚外情後，加密貨幣衍生品市場24 小時內相關合約交易量突破 1.89 億美元，更有交易員開出高達 910 萬美元的做空部位。

黃仁勳在發給公司內部的電子郵件中坦承：「我背叛了我的妻子，我的行為傷害了她和我們的孩子。對於我的所作所為，我沒有任何藉口，並表達深切的歉意。」

輝達隨後將該封郵件公布於官方新聞室，黃仁勳強調將全力配合獨立調查。

輝達董事會則發表聲明表示，已由獨立董事組成的特別委員會在外部律師協助下展開調查，並重申「對黃仁勳及其領導團隊保持信心」。董事會在聲明中進一步澄清，目前「沒有理由相信國家安全或輝達的商業機密遭到妥協」。

此次調查背景源於有報導指稱黃仁勳可能成為外國情報機構鎖定的目標。美國眾議院三個委員會的主席已聯名致函，要求黃仁勳於 11 月 18 日就其與涉嫌中國情報人員的聯繫向國會進行簡報。

報導特別引述前美國聯邦調查局(FBI)局長Christopher Wray過往的警告指出，外國情報機關長期針對美國科技高層進行滲透，並強調「中國政府對美國的經濟與國家安全構成最大的長期威脅」。

由於美股周末休市，投資人轉向去中心化平台 Hyperliquid 交易輝達股票的永續合約。區塊鏈數據分析帳號 Lookonchain 監測發現，有加密巨鯨開立 10 倍槓桿、相當於 3 萬股輝達股票(價值約 544 萬美元)的空單。

根據 Hypurrscan 的統計，加計另外兩筆各約 180 萬美元的空單，周日下午新增的做空部位總額已達 910 萬美元。

受此醜聞影響，在 Blue Ocean 美股夜盤交易中，輝達股價應聲下跌 3.6% 至約 179.87 美元。

news.Title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Just Plowed $27 Million Into a Virtual Monopoly (No, Not Alphabet!)
news.Content:
It's been a year of significant change for trillion-dollar conglomerate Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRKA)(NYSE:BRKB). Longtime leader Warren Buffett retired as CEO at the end of last year, handing the reins to the company's day-to-day operations and its $364 billion investment portfolio to his understudy, Greg Abel.

Abel wasted little time making his mark . He completely overhauled Berkshire's investment portfolio in the first quarter and built up a significant position in Google parent Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG). But Alphabet isn't the only virtual monopoly that the Oracle of Omaha's successor is piling into. Abel is also adding to Berkshire's already sizable stake in satellite-radio operator Sirius XM Holdings (NASDAQ:SIRI).

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Berkshire's new boss, Greg Abel, has found value amid a historically pricey stock market. Image source: Getty Images.

Berkshire's Greg Abel is getting "Sirius"

Usually, investors have to wait until money managers file Form 13F (due Nov. 16) to get an under-the-hood look at what they've been up to. But when beneficial owners (those who hold 10% or more of a public company's outstanding shares) make a trade, they're required to report it via a Form 4 filing within two business days.

Between Oct. 30 and Nov. 3, Abel and his team purchased 924,281 shares of Sirius XM stock for about $27 million. This increased Berkshire Hathaway's stake in the company to more than 125.7 million shares (over 37% of Sirius XM's outstanding shares are held by Berkshire).

The obvious lure of buying Sirius XM stock is its status as a legal monopoly. Although it faces plenty of competition for listeners among terrestrial and online radio providers, Sirius XM is the only licensed satellite-radio operator in the country. This affords it a healthy degree of pricing power over its subscription services.

But it's not just Sirius XM's virtual monopoly status that has Berkshire's current and former bosses intrigued.

A strong argument can be made that Sirius XM's revenue mix is far more important than its monopoly status. Whereas most traditional radio companies rely almost exclusively on advertising revenue to keep the lights on, Sirius XM has generated 21% of its net sales from ads through the first nine months of 2026 and 76% from subscriptions.

Story Continues

When recessions inevitably occur, ad revenue often dries up quickly, putting some traditional radio operators in a bind. This isn't the case for Sirius XM, given that subscribers are far less likely to cancel their services during an economic downturn. In other words, Sirius XM's cash flow is much more consistent than its peers.

Sirius XM also enjoys some level of cost predictability that traditional radio operators don't. While royalty and programming costs are going to vary from quarter to quarter, the company's equipment and transmission expenses should remain stable regardless of how many subscribers it has. This is a recipe for margin expansion over time.

Lastly, Sirius XM offers a value proposition that Warren Buffett's protégé has struggled to find amid a historically expensive stock market. Even though Sirius XM's supercharged growth days are in the rearview mirror, mindful spending, coupled with low-single-digit growth and premier subscription pricing power, has the company trading at just 10 times 2027's forecast earnings.

Virtual monopolies are quickly becoming a staple in Berkshire Hathaway's portfolio under Greg Abel.

news.Title: Vanguard Growth ETF vs. Vanguard Mega Cap Growth ETF: The AI Sell-Off Exposes a Hidden Risk in Both Funds
news.Content:
Two popular funds, the Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF (NYSEMKT:VUG) and Vanguard Morningstar Mega Cap Growth ETF (NYSEMKT:MGK), offer exposure to America's largest growth companies. However, their similarities may matter more than their differences as the recent sell-off in artificial intelligence (AI) and technology stocks highlights the concentration risks facing growth-oriented investors.

While the broader growth fund holds more than twice as many stocks as its mega-cap counterpart, both remain heavily concentrated in the same technology giants, including Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), and Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT). With Wall Street increasingly questioning elevated AI valuations, investors should consider whether owning more companies actually provides meaningful diversification when the market turns against Big Tech.

The Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF offers a slightly broader perspective on the growth space, holding 135 different stocks. Its largest positions are remarkably similar, with Nvidia at 13.48%, Apple at 12.50%, and Microsoft at 9.74%. Despite their different numbers of holdings, these two Vanguard growth ETFs offer remarkably similar exposure. In fact, approximately 87% of their holdings overlap by portfolio weight. That means investors shouldn't expect either fund to provide much protection if the recent weakness across mega-cap technology stocks continues.

Historically, the mega-cap growth fund has delivered slightly stronger long-term returns, benefiting from the dominance of America's largest technology companies. However, the broader growth fund offers exposure to more companies and charges a lower expense ratio of 0.03%, compared with 0.05% for its counterpart. While the cost difference is modest, it matters when the underlying investments are so similar.

For long-term investors, the Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF looks like the better buy. Its broader holdings and slightly lower fees provide a modest advantage without sacrificing meaningful exposure to the companies driving the AI boom. That said, neither fund offers substantial protection from a prolonged technology downturn, making diversification beyond large-cap growth stocks worth considering.

news.Title: 台股強彈難擋外資匯出　新台幣爆量重貶逾1角收32.882元
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北9日電）國安基金護盤助威，台股今天展開絕地大反攻，不過新台幣匯率依舊疲弱，今天收盤收32.882元，重貶1.14角，出口商與外資激烈交鋒之下，交投熱絡，台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額放大至45億美元，為史上第8大量。

台股上週暴跌5510.19點或12.18%，失守4萬點大關，不過美國科技股上週五收紅，加上國安基金宣布進場，大大提振投資人信心。台股今天開高反彈，盤中指數大漲2647點；終場上漲1960.06點，收在41661.7點，創史上第2大收盤漲點。

台股強勢反攻，外資卻未能回心轉意，今天續砍台股900.56億元，已經連續8個交易日賣超，累計提款近8000億元。隨著外資賣股匯出壓力持續籠罩匯市，新台幣匯率跌勢難止，難以跟上台股反彈腳步。

新台幣兌美元今天以32.80元開盤後，外資匯出賣壓迅速湧現，匯價急貶跌破32.9元關卡，出口商則火力全開，積極進場拋匯，力抗外資賣壓，但盤中仍一度下探32.957元，重貶1.89角。

外匯交易員直言，新台幣匯價短線看似守住32元字頭，出口商不再觀望，紛紛把握近期匯價低點進場拋匯，央行也持續坐鎮穩匯；然而，外資匯出浪潮依舊洶湧，遲遲未見回補台股跡象，資金出走壓力未解，新台幣貶勢難以扭轉。

儘管台股今天狂飆1960點，外匯交易員指出，市場存在3大不確定性，新台幣止貶訊號尚未明朗。首先，外資今天持續賣超台股900億元，顯示資金出走壓力尚未解除；其次，美國10月非農就業數據強勁，推升市場對聯準會12月升息的預期，美元指數也在數據公布後應聲走揚。

第三，輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳傳出婚外情風波，輝達發布道歉信，事件更衍生間諜疑雲及晶片國安疑慮，導致輝達股價夜盤重挫。相關事件是否衝擊市場信心，進而澆熄台股甫燃起的反彈動能，仍有待觀察。（編輯：潘羿菁）1151109

news.Title: Jensen Huang just handed Wall Street its first $4.5 trillion CEO scandal
news.Content: Wall Street has priced plenty of CEO scandals. It has never priced one at a company worth $4.5 trillion that makes up nearly 7% of the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ). Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang admitted in a Nov. 8 memo to employees to an affair with Alice Huang, whom US intelligence officials believe worked for China's Ministry of State Security. "I was unfaithful to my wife," he wrote. The board has opened an independent investigation. Nvidia stock fell 5% before the bell on Monday following the news. The scale is hard to overstate. At Friday's close, Nvidia was worth about four times the nine biggest companies ever hit by CEO personal-conduct scandals combined, by Yahoo Finance calculations. The largest, Intel ( INTC ), was worth $249 billion when Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018 over a past consensual relationship with an employee. Nvidia is about 18 times that. This is key-person risk — the danger that a company's value rests on one person — at its most extreme. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has run it ever since, with no named successor. Adjust for a bigger stock market, and the gap narrows but doesn't close. No earlier scandal-hit company made up more than about 1% of the S&P 500, a mark only Intel in 2018 and HP ( HPQ ) in 2010 reached. Nvidia is about seven times that. History puts a price on it. A 2018 study in the Journal of Financial Economics found stocks fell about 4% on average when the CEO was the one caught. At Nvidia's size, that's roughly $185 billion, more than McDonald's ( MCD ) was worth when it fired Steve Easterbrook in 2019. So far, Wall Street has treated Nvidia like the safe chip stock. Since Oct. 28, the last close before The New York Times' first spy report, Nvidia has fallen about 13%. The PHLX Semiconductor Index ( ^SOX ) is down about 20% in a stretch that included a post-midterm rout. The gap holds from Nvidia's Oct. 6 record too. Spy stories can hit hard. Super Micro Computer ( SMCI ) lost 41% in a day in 2018 on a report of Chinese spy chips in its servers, a report that was never confirmed. The closer precedent may be Intel's Lip-Bu Tan. In August 2025, President Trump said Tan should resign over his China ties [1p link?]. Within a month, Washington had taken a stake in Intel and the stock was up about 20%. This time, Trump is in the CEO's corner. "I think he's an honorable guy," he told reporters Sunday. Options traders were braced even before the admission. Friday's prices implied a move of more than 3% either way for Monday alone, more than double Nvidia's typical day lately. Story Continues The bigger bets are on the next week-and-a-half. Nvidia reports earnings Nov. 17, and the next day the Republican chairs of three House committees want Huang at a closed-door briefing. Options expiring Nov. 18 implied a swing of about 11% either way by then. Over a similar stretch around its last eight earnings reports, Nvidia moved about 4% on average, by Yahoo Finance calculations. In January, Democrats take Congress, subpoena power included. Nvidia isn't blinking. "Today's news will not slow NVIDIA," spokesperson John Rizzo said. "Jensen is committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption." Internal AI tools helped analyze interview transcripts, research, and draft this post. Humans reviewed, edited, and fact-checked this post before publication. Jared Blikre is the global markets and data editor for Yahoo Finance. Follow him on X at @SPYJared or email him at jaredblikre@yahooinc.com . news.Title: Tech Sell-Off: The 1 "Magnificent Seven" Stock I'd Buy and the 1 I'd Avoid
news.Content:
The sector driving the stock market boom in recent years isn't as hot as it once was. Tech stocks have plunged in recent weeks, weighed down by concerns about a new rate-hike cycle and soaring artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure spending.

Some members of the so-called "Magnificent Seven" stocks don't look all that magnificent these days. But some also look quite attractive. Here's the Magnificent Seven stock I'd buy hand over fist in the tech sell-off and the one I'd avoid.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Buy: Alphabet

I think Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) offers the most compelling valuation in the Magnificent Seven. Shares of Google's parent trade at 19 times forward earnings.

Granted, Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) sports an even lower forward earnings multiple of 17.7. However, Alphabet is the clear winner with growth prospects factored in. Its price-to-earnings-to-growth (PEG) ratio, based on analysts' five-year earnings growth projections, is 0.51, compared with Meta's 1.35.

There's also only one Magnificent Seven stock that Warren Buffett and his successor, Greg Abel, have favored over the last year. Buffett personally made the call to invest $31 billion of Berkshire Hathaway 's (NYSE: BRKA) (NYSE: BRKB) cash in Alphabet. Although Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) remains Berkshire's largest holding , Alphabet has risen quickly to become the conglomerate's fourth-largest position (including both share classes).

What about Google Search revenue growth slowing significantly in the latest quarter? I view worries about the impact of AI as overblown. Sure, Google chief business officer Philipp Schindler acknowledged on the third-quarter earnings call that AI Overviews negatively impacted revenue growth due to lower monetization.

However, foreign exchange played an even bigger role. Importantly, Google is increasing the number of ads it displays within both AI Overviews and AI Mode. I fully expect AI-related monetization to improve sharply over the next couple of years.

I like Google Cloud's momentum and expect Alphabet's AI infrastructure investments to pay off. I like the optionality that self-driving car unit Waymo offers. I like Google Quantum AI's opportunity in quantum computing. And, yes, I like the long-term future for Google's underlying advertising business. This Magnificent Seven stock is the best pick to buy on the dip, in my opinion.

Story Continues

Avoid: Tesla

Then there's Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA). The electric vehicle (EV) maker's valuation is the exact opposite of Alphabet's. Tesla's shares trade at a staggering 146 times forward earnings.

Don't expect Tesla's growth to paint a better picture of that valuation. The company's revenue declined slightly year over year in Q3.

The harsh reality for Tesla is that the EV market is more competitive than ever. Chinese companies, led by BYD (OTC: BYDDF) (OTC: BYDDY), present a formidable threat.

Tesla's Cybertruck has been an embarrassing flop. The company's long-promised robotaxis are finally operational but have a long way to go to catch up to Waymo's market share.

I'll admit I'm intrigued by Tesla's opportunity to sell humanoid robots. Maybe Musk is right that the company's Optimus robot will be, as he predicted in Tesla's Q3 earnings call, "the biggest product on Earth." However, his track record is spotty at best at delivering on new technology anywhere close to his predicted timeline.

Perhaps a merger with Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX), better known as SpaceX, will change the dynamics for Tesla. My concern, though, is that any deal could be more favorable to SpaceX shareholders than Tesla shareholders.

Unequal magnificence

The bottom line is that the Magnificent Seven stocks aren't equally magnificent. Alphabet tops Tesla on nearly every front, in my opinion. The tech sell-off, therefore, creates a buying opportunity for Alphabet but doesn't make Tesla a great pick right now.

news.Title: Amazon’s Cloud Business Just Did Something It Hasn’t Done in Nearly Five Years
news.Content:
Investors have asked one big question about artificial intelligence (AI) over the past year: Will all of the spending pay off? Tech giants have poured hundreds of billions of dollars into data centers, chips, and power, and during the most recent earnings seasons, shareholders have started to look for proof that customer demand justifies the bill.

Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) just delivered some of the best evidence yet. In the third quarter, revenue growth at Amazon Web Services (AWS), the world's No. 1 cloud services provider, accelerated to its fastest pace in nearly five years. For a business that now generates more than $180 billion in annual revenue, that's a remarkable feat.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The stock didn't exactly celebrate, though. Amazon shares declined in the following trading session as investors focused on the company's enormous spending plans. So let's take a closer look at what AWS accomplished, what's behind it, and what it means for you as an investor.

Image source: Getty Images.

AWS and the AI build-out

First, a quick refresher on the AWS story. Amazon launched the unit back in 2006, and it was known for a variety of cloud services well before the AI boom. In fact, it's long been Amazon's main profit driver. With the arrival of AI, demand for computing capacity soared. Customers turn to AWS for everything from Nvidia 's leading graphics processing units (GPUs) to Amazon's in-house chips, as well as large language models and agentic AI tools.

However, that demand has come at a price. Amazon lifted its 2026 capital spending forecast to $220 billion from $200 billion during the second-quarter report a few months ago, and chief Andy Jassy said even that wouldn't be enough to fully serve demand. Investors have worried about whether revenue would ever catch up with the spending, and now, the latest earnings report, for the third quarter, offers us some evidence.

AWS revenue climbed more than 39% year over year to $46 billion, for the fastest growth rate in nearly five years. The annual revenue run rate now stands at $184 billion. It's rare for a business this large to speed up rather than slow down.

Amazon's profit driver

On top of this, AWS scored a win when it came to profitability, with operating income advancing 55% to more than $17 billion. The unit accounts for about 60% of Amazon's operating income, showing how much the cloud business matters to the bottom line.

Story Continues

All of that is great, but what may be even more encouraging is the outlook, as this offers us a view of revenue to come. AWS has a contracted revenue backlog of $578 billion, for a triple-digit year-over-year gain. And usage of Amazon Bedrock, AWS' AI inference service, is exploding higher, too, with Fortune 500 customers spending about seven times more than a year earlier. Jassy even said that AWS may become a trillion-dollar business within the coming five to 10 years.

In spite of all of this positive news, Amazon still faces a challenge, and it has to do with the spending levels. Spending is weighing on free cash flow today, and Amazon says it will continue to do so until the company can monetize its new data centers. Any potential slowdown in AI demand could lengthen this timeline, and this risk has prompted some investors to avoid Amazon stock as well as the shares of other cloud giants.

But here's some good news. The third-quarter numbers suggest the investment is meeting demand rather than chasing it. The evidence is faster growth, rising profits, and a strong backlog.

So, where does that leave investors? Amazon's cloud business is accelerating at a scale few companies have ever reached, and management expects the momentum to last through at least 2028. The stock could swing in the short term given the spending, but for long-term investors, Amazon looks like a great stock to own.

台股大反攻！收漲1960點站回4萬1，寫下史上第二大收盤漲點。今(9)日加權指數盤中一度大漲2647.72點，終場上漲1960.06點、漲幅4.94%，收41,661.70點，收復部分上周跌幅，上市成交金額為8393.67億元。國安基金宣示護盤、金管會祭出限空等穩市措施，搭配美股科技股反彈，提振市場信心；電子類股上漲5.49%，金融類股漲2.35%，櫃買指數也有強彈5.90%的表現。

台積電(2330)盤中最高來到2290元，終場上漲100元、漲幅4.68%，收2235元。跌深電子權值股領軍反攻，聯發科(2454)、台達電(2308)齊攻漲停；被動元件族群也掀亮燈潮，國巨(2327)、華新科(2492)等同步漲停，光學股則由大立光(3008)強勢亮燈，成為反攻焦點。記憶體族群華邦電(2344)、旺宏(2337)等也漲停響應。PCB與上游材料股同樣強勢，金像電(2368)、華通(2313)、台玻(1802)漲停；傳產部分，台塑(1301)、南亞(1303)、台化(1326)也鎖一字紅燈作收，上市櫃合計237檔股票亮燈，反彈買氣由電子擴散至傳產。

亞股收盤漲跌互見，日經指數上漲2.33%，上海綜合指數上漲0.32%；韓國綜合指數由漲翻跌，下跌0.81%，香港恆生指數也下跌0.22%。

📝盤點熱門股：主動中信台灣收益、元大台灣50正2、群益臺灣加權正2

台股強勢反攻，熱門成交榜前五名全由ETF包辦，前四檔同步走揚，僅反向ETF收黑。主動式ETF方面，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)以86.61萬張奪下成交王，配息題材持續吸引買盤，持股人數再創新高，加上持股多檔盤中亮燈，帶動交投熱絡、股價勁揚；排名第四的主動統一台股增長(00981A)也強勢收紅。

槓桿型ETF同樣人氣沸騰，元大台灣50正2(00631L)、群益臺灣加權正2(00685L)分居第二、三名，雙雙大幅反彈。 分析師指出 ，國安基金宣示護盤提振資金回補信心，搭配美股反彈，帶動正2ETF買氣升溫。相較之下，第五名元大台灣50反1(00632R)則逆勢走低。

📌三大法人買賣超

三大法人今日合計賣超945.26億元，其中，外資大舉賣超900.56億元，成為法人賣壓主力；投信逆勢買超267.49億元，自營商則賣超312.19億元。整體來看，法人操作呈現分歧，投信積極承接，但外資與自營商同步站在賣方，合計仍呈大幅賣超。

✨本日議題股：被動元件概念股

被動元件族群今日隨大盤展開跌深反攻，國巨(2327)開盤約15分鐘便鎖住411元漲停價，重返400元大關，盤中吸引1.3萬張買單排隊；華新科(2492)則有獲利成長撐腰，股價盤中攻上284元漲停，力拚終結連六跌。凱美(2375)、立隆電(2472)、千如(3236)等也同步亮燈，族群買氣全面回溫...... 點我看更多

news.Title: 京站看今年周年慶不好做 台股下跌「一定影響消費力」
news.Content:
百貨商場京站(2942-TW)今(9)日指出，周年慶自11月18日開跑，而全台展店計畫也持續推進中，桃園店、高雄世運站周邊A5街廓都市更新案二大據點確定，蓄勢待發迎向更廣闊的市場版圖，但就短期來看，京站不諱言這波股市下跌「一定影響消費力，再加上選舉效應，越靠近選舉也會影響來客人潮，今年周年慶沒有那麼好做」。

京站總經理王大政表示，全台展店計畫持續推進中，其中，桃園店預計於2029年開幕，而由母公司日勝生打造的高雄捷運R17世運站周邊A5街廓都市更新案，將有2層樓京站百貨商場，預計於本月正式舉行動土典禮，目標將軌道經濟與質感生活體驗商場完美結合。

王大政不諱言，這波股市下跌一定會影響消費力，「其實10月整個業績就不是很好，颱風假影響、台股下跌等因素，今年周年慶沒有那麼好做」，而選舉活動牽動人潮位移，也會影響百貨來客，成長就是要靠同仁大家的努力。

京站時尚廣場為強化周年慶商機，樓管與客服同仁進行大規模換新裝，且一口氣完成全館50幾個櫃位改裝升級，以強化美食品牌版圖，目前餐飲業績占館內營收比重逾40%，預估周年慶整體業績將年增3%。

此外，京站過去透過入股京饌餐旅(百八魚場母公司)67%股權，納入其三大餐飲品牌，目標明年上半年再開出一個新品牌，但並直指人才難找且訓練需要時間。

京站時尚廣場為迎接周年慶商機進行餐飲大改裝，亮點包括全台首櫃來自日本的排隊人氣甜點BEL BUTTER WAFFLE 比利時鬆餅、西區首家的APINARA泰式餐廳，翰林茶棧全新「關東煮板前」店型等，周年慶預計11月18日至12月14日盛大展開。

news.Title: 《韓股》憂AI變數 KOSPI收跌0.81%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-09 16:56:05 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(9)日走弱，韓國KOSPI指數收於5018.85點，下跌40.84點或0.81%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於638.97點，下跌5.30點或0.82%。盤中雖一度反彈，但尾盤未能守住漲幅，主因仍是美國AI資料中心政策疑慮、Nvidia相關不確定性等，共同壓抑風險偏好。

外部環境方面，市場焦點集中在美國AI題材的變數。中期選舉後，對AI資料中心監管可能趨嚴的憂慮升溫，加上Nvidia內部調查消息延續科技股波動，韓股即使跟隨美股半導體反彈，也難以形成穩定追價力道。整體來看，盤面仍偏向觀望，資金對高評價科技股更為謹慎。

半導體與權值股方面，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)與SK hynix(000660.KS)小幅收紅，成為KOSPI指數少數支撐力量，半導體族群也一度帶動指數反彈。不過，LG Energy Solution(373220.KS)、Samsung SDI(006400.KS)、Hyundai Motor(005380.KS)與Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150.KS)等權值股同步走低，抵銷了晶片股的正面貢獻，指數因此無法延續上行。

記憶體價格飆升，AI長約鎖單與封測爬坡成為漲勢續航關鍵

news.Title: 台股狂飆1960點！郭哲榮曝0050賺逾2000萬：這10檔飆股續看好
news.Content:
台股今（9）日在美國科技股反彈、國安基金宣布啟動第10次護盤及金管會祭出穩市措施激勵下，展開強勁反攻，加權指數盤中最高大漲2647點，終場收在41661.70點，大漲1960.06點，漲幅4.94%，成交金額達8379.29億元，寫下 史上第二大收盤漲點紀錄 。 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮 直呼「 哲哲 又做到了！」透露上週五台股重挫時，再砸5000萬元加碼元大台灣50（0050），累計投入2億元，並點名國巨（2327）、環球晶（6488）、群聯（8299）等10檔個股，認為跌深反彈行情才剛開始。

【台股狂飆1960點！郭哲榮加碼0050：累計投入2億元】

郭哲榮表示，上週五（6日）台股遭遇重挫，指數一度跌至37837點，他選擇在市場最恐慌時再投入5000萬元買進0050，累計已投入2億元。他認為，這次加碼位置相當接近低點，隨著今天台股強勢反彈，從上週五低點計算，0050持有部位已經明顯回升。

郭哲榮也表示，自己上週四就曾呼籲政府應該讓國安基金進場護盤，從政治及選舉壓力評估，認為政府不會坐視市場持續重挫，果然國安基金在上週五晚間宣布啟動第10次護盤。

他認為，國安基金進場不只是資金面的支撐，更重要的是穩定市場信心。過去9次護盤，除了第一次出現虧損，其餘8次均獲利退場，這次再度出手，也讓市場多了一股支撐力量。

郭哲榮重申，自己仍看好台股年底挑戰5萬點，短線則先觀察11月底前能否重新站回4萬5000點。

【被動元件、矽晶圓、記憶體：郭哲榮點名10檔飆股】

今天台股反彈氣勢驚人，盤面超過百檔個股亮燈漲停。郭哲榮認為，這次反彈不只有權值股帶頭，中小型電子股也出現強勁買盤，尤其被動元件、矽晶圓、記憶體及半導體族群，都有值得留意的機會。

1. 被動元件：國巨（2327）、華新科（2492）

郭哲榮看好AI高階產品需求持續成長，加上後續擴產規劃，被動元件產業仍有發展空間。國巨（2327）與華新科（2492）今天同步攻上漲停，他認為，經過前一波整理後，兩檔個股仍有繼續反攻的機會。

2. 矽晶圓：環球晶（6488）、中美晶（5483）、台勝科（3532）

矽晶圓族群也是郭哲榮特別看好的方向。他指出，環球晶（6488）先前修正幅度相當深，股價幾乎打到三折，市場反應過度悲觀。

他看好明年矽晶圓報價調漲的機會，加上客戶拉貨及新廠產能逐步交付，產業供需有望改善。今天環球晶直接攻上漲停，中美晶（5483）、台勝科（3532）也同步

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》新式核能—OKLO、LEU、SMR
news.Content:

Oklo（OKLO.US）

11月6日，Oklo宣布與U.S.Forged Rings,Inc.簽署策略性製造協議，為Aurora未來機組預留美國本土大型鍛件產能，首批交付時點為2030年、安排延伸至2035年。合作涵蓋反應爐壓力容器、上蓋與支撐結構，對應其供應鏈落地節點。

Centrus Energy（LEU.US）

NuScale Power（SMR.US）

本週資料顯示，NuScale與Doosan Enerbility簽署77MWe機型上部反應爐冷卻系統製造協議，對應標準化NuScale Power Module產品線。其77MWe設計已於2025年5月獲美國核能管理委員會（NRC）核准，顯示公司正把設計核准推進到供應製造端。

11月5日，Fluor獲X-energy選定，將為華盛頓州Cascade Advanced Energy Facility提供核島工程、設計與專案管理服務。該案首期部署4座Xe-100、合計320MWe，顯示X-energy路線已把前期監管推進延伸到工程執行與供應鏈整備。

Constellation Energy（CEG.US）

本週資料顯示，美國能源部對Constellation Energy提供最高50億美元有條件融資支持，用於既有核電資產增容，公司並與PSEG Power評估Salem核電廠200MW增量方案。短期主軸明確落在既有核能擴容，而非新建機組。

BWX Technologies（BWXT.US）

本週資料顯示，BWX Technologies取得美國陸軍Fort Campbell微型反應爐部署合約，屬22億美元的Janus計畫一部分，且該案正朝2028年底建造目標推進。這是軍用場景下微型反應爐由計畫走向部署的具體節點。

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉中國10月CPI攀升0.7% 三大指數漲跌互見
news.Content:
中國股市A股三大指數周一（9日）收盤漲跌互見，國家統計局公布的數據顯示，10月消費者物價指數（CPI）較一年前上升0.7%。

上證指數周一收報3,660.79點，漲0.32%。深證成指收報11,145.49點，跌0.27%。創業板指收報2,458.56點，跌0.27%。

中國國家統計局公布的數據顯示，10月 CPI較一年前上升0.7%。其中，城市上漲0.7%，農村上漲0.7%；食品價格下降2.9%，非食品價格上漲1.5%；消費品價格上漲0.8%，服務價格上漲0.7%。

今年1～10月平均CPI比上年同期上漲0.9%。

與9月相比，10月CPI持平。其中，城市持平，農村下降0.1%；食品價格下降1.0%，非食品價格上漲0.2%；消費品價格下降0.1%，服務價格上漲0.1%。

10月生產者物價指數（全國工業生產者出廠價格，PPI）較去年同期上漲5.7%，較9月上漲0.7%。

工業生產者購進價格較一年前上漲7.9%，較9月上漲1.1%。

今年1～10月平均，PPI比上年同期上漲2.7%，工業生產者購進價格上漲4.0%。

news.Title: 外資上週倒貨5243億！ 力積電、台積電砍逾8萬張 「這檔」逆勢狂買9萬張
news.Content:
上週外資在集中市場大砍逾5,243億元，累計今年賣超逼近2.9兆元，總持股市值更一口氣大減超過8.7兆元，資金大挪移備受市場矚目。

news.Title: 名師操盤》台股萬點重挫後迎轉機 國安基金護盤12檔指標股出列
news.Content:
上周台股因美國期中選舉後資料中心政策的不確定性，導致科技股賣壓出籠；加上市場擔憂AI巨額投資的回收速度、外資持續撤出亞洲市場、新台幣走弱，讓原先高評價的電子股接連遭到調節，周五指數盤中最低來到37837點，從10月高點至今跌逾萬點，恐慌情緒明顯升高。不過，指數當天自低點反彈近1900點，晚間美股那斯達克也反彈1.1%，台指期夜盤站回4萬點，更重要的是，國安基金在周五收盤後決議授權視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，金管會也宣布周一起實施限空等穩市措施；政策與海外科技股回穩，有機會讓本周先從「反彈」角度出發。

若回顧過往九次國安基金護盤，按宣布後下一交易日進場、持有一年的指數回測，九次中有七次上漲，機率約77.8%。但這不代表政策宣布當天就是最低點，過去也曾在護盤後再度破底。因此政策能做的是先穩定信心，後續仍須檢驗三個止穩條件：一是外資賣壓收斂、逐步重返買超；二是新台幣止貶回升；三是台指與現貨不再破低，反彈後帶出新的高點，確認價量轉勢。三者若能陸續出現，台股築底的基礎才會更加穩固。

族群方面，這次要先看能否拉動指數的權值股。半導體以台積電、聯發科為主要觀察指標，日月光投控、聯電可同步留意；AI電源及伺服器則觀察台達電、鴻海，廣達、緯穎也值得追蹤。周五台積電一度觸及跌停，隨後跌幅收斂，顯示低檔已有承接；但權值股要重新凝聚市場信心，仍須守住低點，並逐步站回先前跌破的密集成交區。若只有指數反彈、櫃買與多數個股仍然走弱，也很難說盤勢已全面回穩。

另外，金融權值也可一併觀察。富邦金、國泰金、中信金、兆豐金若能止穩，代表承接不只集中在電子股，對指數的支撐會更完整，上次國安基金曾布局台積電、台達電、鴻海、廣達、聯發科、日月光投控及富邦金，但本次實際標的尚未公布，仍應以市場價量判斷。整體而言，短線先看反彈能否延續；只有權值股與外資籌碼同步改善，才有條件從反彈走向落底。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》國安基金提振信心 大漲1960點/重返41K
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-09 15:55:05 新聞中心 發佈

美股四大指數上週五(6日)漲多跌少，台股今(9)日在國安基金宣示護盤以及金管會祭出限空令等因素激勵下，呈強勢反彈走勢，由台積電、聯發科、鴻海、台達電和日月光投控等電子權值股領漲，盤中一度大漲2647點，重新站上4萬2關卡，惟部分傳產族群漲勢相對溫吞，指數呈現高檔橫盤整理，加權指數終場漲勢略有收斂，收在41661.7點，上漲1960.06點或4.94%，創下收盤第二大漲點，成交量8379.29億元。

隨著逢低買盤搶入，AI晶片與資料中心基礎建設概念股上週五全面反彈，但那斯達克指數仍已連續第4週走跌，投資人正在尋找線索，判斷AI交易接下來將如何演變。亞洲股市方面，因日經225指數6日暴跌3,643點，創下史上第3大單日跌點，吸引投資人逢低買進，AI、半導體相關股飆漲，激勵日經指數9日強彈，終場上漲2.33%；韓國股市今日走勢疲弱，盤中雖翻紅、一度站上5172點，惟未能延續反彈走勢，KOSPI終場下跌0.81%。

國安基金進場護盤，激勵台股強勢收高，加權指數終場收在41661.7點，上漲1960點。從盤面表現來看，資金積極回流多頭族群，帶動指數一路走高，顯示市場信心明顯轉強。電子族群漲勢強勁，台積電開高走高，受在2235元，上漲4.68%，奇鋐、台達電、鴻勁、國巨*、聯發科、智邦等都亮燈漲停，創意、健策、南亞科、台光電、鴻海、日月光投控、川湖、緯穎等也都漲勢凌厲。

類股表現方面，今日盤面最具代表性的三大強勢族群分別為塑膠股最為強勢，漲幅9.45%，其中台塑、台化、南亞都衝上漲停，玻璃陶瓷股上漲9.35%，電子零組件股也勁揚7.58%，包含金像電、華新科、富世達、台虹、華通等都亮燈漲停。多數傳產與電子同步走揚，顯示買盤擴散效果明顯，不再僅由單一族群撐盤。整體而言，今日大盤在權值與族群輪動帶動下強彈，指數與成交量同步放大，有助後續多方延續攻勢，不過在短線急漲後，後續仍須觀察高檔震盪與追價力道是否延續。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人總計賣超945.26億元；其中，外資及陸資(不含外資自營商)賣超900.56億元，投信買超267.48億元，自營商賣超312.18億元。

news.Title: 波克夏擬再發日元債 瑞穗與美銀擔綱承銷
news.Content:
美國投資巨頭波克夏·海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)(BRK.B-US)已委任瑞穗證券與美銀證券擔任主辦承銷商，籌備今年4月以來，首次發行日元計價公司債，預計近期視市場狀況正式發行。

波克夏近年保持每年發行約兩次日元債的節奏。今年4月，公司曾發行6檔年限介於3年至30年的日元債，總額達2,723億日元(約17億美元)，為其自2019年首度發債以來規模較大的發行之一。

近期日本企業債市場因10月供應量暴增導致信用利差擴大，新債發行節奏有所放緩。對於本次發債展望，Resona Asset Management Co.固定收益投資部首席基金經理人藤原貴志指出：「波克夏因投資日本股票在當地擁有極高知名度，只要提供適當的信用利差，投資人對其債券應該會有強勁需求。」

波克夏過往將發行日元債籌得的資金投入日股，包括三菱商事、三井物產等五大商社及東京海上控股等企業股票。現任執行長阿貝爾(Greg Abel)曾透露擬長期持有並可能加碼商社股份，引發市場預期本次籌資將繼續挹注日本股市，帶動五大商社與日股走強。

在財務與市場表現方面，波克夏截至今年9月底擁有高達3,774億美元的現金與流動資產，並於近期在全球科技股修正時逆勢刷新股價歷史新高。

對此，CFRA資深分析師 Cathy Seifert 表示，波克夏強健的資產負債表實力、多元化經營與庫藏股買回政策提供穩固支撐，吸引資金轉向波動較低、品質較高的企業。

news.Title: 美股急跌，是危機來了還是市場太恐慌？
news.Content:
美股急跌，就代表美國經濟與企業獲利也跟著失速了嗎？政策疑慮可能放大市場波動，但股價全面下跌，並不等於各產業的需求、訂單與獲利都同步轉弱。判斷這波跌勢是否反映經濟前景改變，仍需回到政策的實際影響與企業財報，觀察基本面是否出現持續惡化的跡象。

1. AI政策疑慮不等於所有產業轉弱

美國期中選舉後，市場擔心AI監管趨嚴、資料中心建設受到限制，帶動美股下跌。這些政策確實可能影響晶片、設備及相關基礎設施業者的成長預期，但昨天標普500的11大類股全數收黑，代表賣壓已經超出AI相關產業，擴散到整體市場。

我們認為，單憑AI政策疑慮，尚不足以合理解釋所有類股全面下跌，這波市場反應已偏向過度。各產業與AI投資的關聯程度不同，即使部分資料中心建設放慢，也不代表所有企業的訂單、消費需求與獲利都會同步轉弱。在經濟與企業獲利仍有支撐的情況下，這種全面性的拋售，反映出投資人對政策風險的過度放大。

2. 企業基本面仍穩健

據彭博第三季財報統計，標普500已有逾八成企業公布財報，目前整體營收成長13.2%、盈餘成長28.0%。更值得關注的是，成長動能並未侷限於少數AI公司。標普500的11大產業，營收與盈餘均呈現正成長，其中科技與工業的盈餘分別成長66.4%及36.2%，金融、醫療與消費相關產業也持續成長。雖然各產業成長速度不同，但財報反映的是多數產業仍在擴張，尚未出現整體企業營運全面轉弱的情況。

判斷政策風險是否改變美股前景，關鍵在於它是否進一步影響企業訂單、營收及獲利展望。目前財報呈現的成長動能，仍支持企業基本面穩健的判斷。因此，面對短期股價急跌，投資人可持續追蹤企業後續展望，不必直接將市場的悲觀情緒，視為企業獲利已經轉差。

3. 急跌後仍有修復機會

從歷史回測來看，市場急跌後，拉長時間仍有修復機會。標普500、台灣加權、費城半導體與那斯達克指數，在事件後三個月、六個月及一年的平均報酬均為正值。短期恐慌未必會延續，若因市場急跌便全面退場，也可能錯過後續修復的機會。

鉅亨投資策略

面對市場急跌，我們認為目前美國經濟與企業基本面仍穩健，短期政策疑慮尚不足以改變整體成長趨勢，投資人不必因恐慌而急於全面退場。資產配置上，可透過科技、金融、醫療及民生消費等不同類股分散風險，降低對單一產業或AI題材的依賴，並依原定配置比例分

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資狂吃台股豆腐...重砍900億元 賣超聯電近4.8萬張居冠 再提款台積電195億元
news.Content:
（下午4點30分更新買賣超個股）

國安基金啟動第十度護盤，激勵台股今（9）日強勢反攻，創史上第二大單日收盤漲點，但三大法人仍合計賣超945.26億元，其中外資「狂吃豆腐」再砍900.56億元，重砍聯電（2303）近4.8萬張，同步提款台積電（2330）逾195億元，淨空單更突破10萬口、創下新高。兆豐國際投顧董事長留政鈺表示，外資主要仍因應美股波動與不確定性，進行全球資產配置調整、降低科技股部位；台股今日反彈則有信心回升、融券回補及內資買盤支撐，但他認為漲勢「有一點反應過度」，後續須觀察美國通膨數據及重要企業財報。

外資賣超前三大：聯電、00631L、0050

晶圓代工「二哥」聯電（2303）今日遭外資大砍47,956張，居賣超第一；元大台灣50正2（00631L）遭減碼43,364張，排名第二；元大台灣50（0050）則被賣超38,281張，位居第三。

值得關注的是，載板雙雄欣興（3037）被調節10,836張，位居第六，景碩（3189）也被賣超8,758張，進入外資調節名單。

另外，權王台積電今日收盤上漲100元、收在2,235元，漲幅4.68%，股價強彈之際，外資卻續站在賣方、大幅出脫8,758張，若以收盤價估算，約提款195.74億元。

統計外資已連續22個交易日累計賣超台積電高達25萬4,764張。

外資買超前三大：00406A、00981A、00403A

外資今日前十大買超標的中，ETF一口氣包辦7席，買超冠軍由主動中信台灣收益（00406A）拿下，單日買超208,827張；第二名為主動統一台股增長（00981A），獲搶進72,059張；第三名主動統一升級50（00403A），買超39,582張。

個股方面，華航（2610）獲外資買超24,488張，排名第六；台玻（1802）以18,574張排名第八，宏碁（2353）則獲買超15,665張，位居第十。

外資狂吃台股豆腐...重砍900億元 空單飆破10萬口新高

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計賣超945.26億元，其中外資再砍900.56億元，連8賣累計提款7,957.15億元

投信續站買方，買超267.49億元，連續20個交易日買超台股達3,804.8億元。

自營商合計賣超312.19億元，其中自行買賣部分賣超63.82億元，避險操作賣超248.37億元。

今日股匯脫鉤，新台幣兌美元截至下午2時30分報32.940元，貶值1.72角；在外資淨空單部分，前一交易日為9萬9,930口，今日則為10萬1,771口，寫下歷史新高。

美股波動牽動全球配置 外資減碼科技股降風險

留政鈺直言，「美股面臨很大的波動跟不確定性」，外資因此同步調整全球資金配置，尤其降低科技股曝險。他表示，前兩周已出現資金由股票轉向債券的情況，目的在於降低整體投資風險。因此，外資何時減輕賣壓，關鍵仍在美股波動能否下降，以及市場是否逐漸認為風險可控。相較之下，台股今日反彈有信心回升、融券回補及內資買盤支撐，與外資著眼全球配置的考量不同。

就業數據優於預期 CPI、企業現金流成觀察重點

留政鈺表示，外資主要觀察市場資金及產業財報兩大面向，上周五美國公布的10月非農就業人數明顯高於市場預期，加上本周即將公布CPI，市場仍須評估利率前景，尤其通膨數據對12月升息預期相當關鍵。企業方面，市場關注雲端業者自由現金流缺口及籌資需求，重要財報公布前，資金仍有觀望。他觀察，今日上午10點多後，美國科技股期貨開始下跌，台股約在10點半後也轉為高檔震盪，反映國際市場變化仍牽動盤勢。

利空估已反映七至八成

留政鈺強調，國安基金是「守而不攻」，主要在大跌時穩定市場，今日台股反彈幅度相較日韓較大，他認為「反應有點過度」，後續仍須回歸國際股市。目前大型企業財報公布已進入尾聲，判斷相關利空已反映約七至八成，待通膨數據與重要財報公布、風險逐漸明朗後，再觀察外資賣壓是否減輕。
