news.Title: What MKS (MKSI) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in MKS Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

MKS beat its Q3 2026 guidance: Revenue rose 43% year over year to $1.41 billion, and adjusted EPS more than doubled to $4.18. It forecast Q4 revenue of $1.49 billion and adjusted EPS of $5.00 at the midpoints.

Semiconductor and AI-related demand fueled growth. Semiconductor revenue climbed 54% to $638 million, while electronics and packaging revenue rose 43% to $415 million; AI applications are expected to make up about one-third of that segment's Q4 revenue.

Capacity and profitability are key priorities. MKS is expanding manufacturing to meet strong demand, including chemistry equipment orders booked into 2028, while Q3 adjusted operating margin reached an eight-year-plus high of 27.8%. It generated $243 million in free cash flow and authorized a $500 million share repurchase program.

3 High-Growth Unknowns in Photonics That Are Vital for AI

MKS (NASDAQ:MKSI) reported third-quarter 2026 revenue and adjusted earnings above its guidance as demand for semiconductor equipment and AI-related electronics manufacturing drove growth across its businesses.

Revenue rose 43% from a year earlier to $1.41 billion, while adjusted earnings more than doubled to $4.18 per diluted share. The company projected fourth-quarter revenue of $1.49 billion, plus or minus $40 million, and adjusted earnings of $5 per share, plus or minus 38 cents.

→ Apple's Earnings Beat Comes With a Catch for Investors Heading Into the Holidays

The 3 Favored Machinery Stocks To Buy In August

President and CEO John Lee said customer orders remained strong and visibility had improved. He attributed the growth to investments in semiconductor manufacturing and electronics packaging, including demand tied to artificial intelligence.

Semiconductor Demand and Capacity Plans

Semiconductor revenue increased 54% year over year to $638 million, supported by demand for DRAM and logic applications and increased NAND upgrade activity, Executive Vice President and CFO Ram Mayampurath said. Revenue also rose 15% from the prior quarter.

→ Are the Fears Around Alphabet's Search Slowdown Warranted?

Lee said a leading foundry selected MKS's dissolved gas solutions for advanced logic. The company also won a pulsed DC power application in conductor etch, displacing an incumbent supplier at an existing customer. Lee declined to quantify the win but said he believed it would be significant in the future.

For the fourth quarter, MKS expects semiconductor revenue of $700 million, plus or minus $15 million. Lee said he expects the company to continue growing faster than the wafer fabrication equipment market in 2027, though he did not provide a specific growth forecast for that year.

Story Continues

→ Palantir's $2.3 Billion Quarter Puts Its Premium Valuation to the Test

MKS is preparing its manufacturing operations for a wafer fabrication equipment market approaching $300 billion in 2028, Lee said. Its Malaysia super center is expected to ramp over the coming quarters, and the company also plans capacity expansion in North America and Europe.

Lee said there was little supply-chain constraint reflected in the company's current revenue guidance, although that could change. He also acknowledged that shortages of critical parts made by other suppliers could eventually limit customers' ability to build complete tools and affect MKS shipments.

AI Drives Electronics and Packaging Growth

Electronics and packaging revenue rose 43% year over year to $415 million. Chemistry revenue grew 26% after excluding foreign-exchange effects and palladium pass-through, which MKS said was the strongest growth rate in the business's history.

Lee said chemistry equipment sales increased more than 75% in the third quarter from a year earlier. MKS expects full-year sales of more than $300 million, compared with a historical annual peak of less than $200 million.

Current chemistry equipment capacity is sold out through 2027, with orders booked for delivery well into 2028. MKS is expanding capacity in Guangzhou, China, and expects the project to double its overall capacity when completed, targeted for the third quarter of 2027. Lee said the company would try to accelerate that timeline.

AI-related applications are expected to account for about 25% of total electronics and packaging revenue in 2026, up approximately 180% in dollar terms from the prior year. At the midpoint of fourth-quarter guidance, MKS expects roughly one-third of the segment's revenue to come from AI-related applications.

Lee said the company is beginning to see consumables revenue from equipment shipped several quarters ago. Its proprietary chemistries have an attach rate above 85% to its installed equipment base, he said, and carry gross margins well above the corporate average. Most of the third-quarter chemistry growth, however, came from equipment already in the field rather than recently installed machines.

MKS also reported new orders for rigid printed circuit board laser systems, including for optical modules, with deliveries expected to accelerate in 2027. Lee said industry constraints had created an opportunity for the company to gain share in rigid PCB drilling.

Margins, Cash Flow and Outlook

Third-quarter gross margin was 47.7%, including a 30-basis-point benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds that MKS does not expect to recur in the fourth quarter. Adjusted operating margin rose about 700 basis points year over year to 27.8%, the company's highest quarterly level in more than eight years.

Mayampurath said lower-margin chemistry equipment sales and manufacturing expansion costs were weighing on gross margin, even as higher volumes helped. He expects those headwinds to continue into 2027 but said they could become longer-term tailwinds as consumables revenue grows and new capacity reaches fuller utilization.

The company generated $243 million in free cash flow during the quarter and ended it with $676 million in cash and cash equivalents. Its net leverage ratio fell to 2.4 times trailing 12-month adjusted EBITDA, within its target of 2.5 times.

MKS made a €50 million term loan prepayment during the quarter and another $100 million payment on its dollar term loan after quarter-end, bringing year-to-date prepayments above $450 million. Its board also authorized a $500 million share repurchase program. Mayampurath said organic investment and debt management would remain priorities, while the company would consider buybacks opportunistically.

Specialty industrial revenue rose 27% year over year to $360 million, led by datacom and general industrial demand. MKS expects fourth-quarter revenue in that market to remain at approximately the same level. Lee also noted the company's previously announced agreement to sell its Ophir Optics business to TTM Technologies.

MKS expects to provide more detail on its strategy and margin outlook at its investor day in New York City on Dec. 14.

About MKS (NASDAQ:MKSI)

MKS Instruments, Inc (NASDAQ: MKSI) develops technologies that enable precision control and measurement in manufacturing and research environments. The company provides instruments, components, systems and process-control solutions used to measure and control pressure, flow, vacuum, gas delivery, temperature and other critical production conditions.

Its product portfolio includes vacuum solutions, pressure and flow-control instruments, gas and vapor delivery systems, plasma and reactive-gas technologies, power delivery systems, process-monitoring equipment, analytical instruments and materials-characterization tools.

news.Title: 美藍色浪潮激發恐慌性拋售，Kospi指數週五重挫324.11點或6.02%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】韓國股市週五走跌，因市場愈發擔心民主黨橫掃美國國會之後，可能拖累人工智能(AI)基礎建設熱潮。收盤時，Kospi指數重挫324.11點或6.02%，報5,059.69點；追蹤創業板市場行情的Kosdaq指數則是滑落34.14點或5.03%，報644.27點。

韓國交易所開盤後不久一度暫停交易20分鐘。全球股市週四遭遇重挫，那斯達克100指數下跌6.4%，市值創紀錄地蒸發2.3兆美元。

這波跌勢將韓股主要指數拖至總統李在明2025年設定的5,000目標之下。隨著AI熱潮推升晶片製造商獲利，Kospi此前迅速突破這一目標，但市場對AI前景的疑慮升高後，Kospi已較6月創下的歷史高點暴跌46%，5,000再度成為市場焦點。

Zian Investment Management首席執行長Kim Dojoon表示，最終，我們已經進入恐慌性拋售階段。在週五這樣的市場中，大多數市場參與者恐怕都會被迫賣出。

盤中韓股大盤跌幅收窄，監管機構採取措施，放寬融資(Margin Loan)規則，暫時舒緩韓國市場的壓力。

韓國政府發表聯合聲明稱，將暫時豁免證券公司必須持有價值至少相當於其保證金貸款140%的抵押品的規定，此舉旨在防止強制拋售加劇股市波動。該豁免期將從11月9日起持續三個月。

韓國有關當局一致認為，韓國股市對外部因素反應過度，這些外部因素包括人工智能政策的不確定性以及全球投資情緒的疲軟。

Fibonacci資產管理全球公司首席執行長Jung In Yun表示，這是一個值得歡迎且務實的舉措，可以打破股價下跌引發強制拋售和進一步下跌的惡性循環。儘管它無法消除波動性，但可以降低有序調整演變為無序清算的風險。

個股表現方面，三星電子股價下跌6.35%；SK海力士股價下滑10.44%；LG Uplus股價上漲5.21%；重山風力公司股價上揚3.48%。

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股崩跌創多項紀錄　台積電跌105元創史上收盤第2大
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年11月6日電）台股今天震盪2598.78點，並創下多項紀錄，包括崩跌3737.67點創史上盤中最大跌點、台積電跌停重挫220元創史上盤中最大跌點、台指期早盤跌停至37694點，加權指數收跌1873.08點創史上收盤第4大跌點，多檔權值股包括台積電、聯發科、台達電、日月光投控、聯電等開盤跳空跌停。

台股午盤在4萬點關卡多空激烈交戰，成交值在中午12時之後即突破新台幣兆元；尾盤台積電、聯發科、鴻海、台達電、日月光投控、南亞科、南亞等權值股跌幅收斂，終場指數下跌1873.08點，失守4萬點關卡，收在39701.64點，留長下影線1078.71點，跌幅4.51%，成交值放大至新台幣1兆2461.04億元。

電子指數挫跌4.93%，金融指數跌3.16%；代表中小型股的櫃買OTC指數下挫5.43%。

權王台積電早盤跌停2020元大跌220元，創史上最大跌點後打開，一度拉升至2195元；終場收2135元，跌105元，創史上收盤第2大跌點，跌幅4.69%，市值蒸發達2.72兆元，降至55.36兆元。

電子權值股聯發科 (2454) 收3390元、跌2.02%，台達電 (2308) 收1055元、跌6.64%，鴻海 (2317) 收224.5元、跌4.47%。日月光投控 (3711) 收527元、跌7.87%，聯電 (2303) 收92元、跌6.5%。

記憶體族群南亞科 (2408) 收343.5元，跌4.58%；被動元件大廠國巨 (2327) 收374元，跌7.54%。

股價超過千元的高價股綠油油一片，股王信驊 (5274) 鎖跌停11375元，高價股降至「38千金」。

儘管電子權值股跌勢收斂，不過散熱族群包括奇鋐、雙鴻、健策等超過千元高價股鎖住跌停；中小型股包括封測與IC載板廠京元電、南電等跌停，銅箔基板聯茂、被動元件禾伸堂也弱勢跌停。

相較之下生技族群逆勢抗跌，其中，藥華藥午盤翻揚漲逾7%，保瑞翻紅勁揚2.7%，資訊服務類股相對有撐。

中國信託證券投顧總經理陳柏州指出，台股短線先求止跌、再看反彈，年線約38834點有支撐力道，翻揚走勢未變，此次台股跌勢急又深，反彈機會仍在；另觀察美國費城半導體指數何時止穩回到年線之上，以及台股融資何時有效減肥。

陳柏州表示，台股從10月6日歷史高點49968.92點迄今盤中低點37837.05點，跌幅已超過24%，融資減幅相對較少，融資餘額若要跟上指數跌幅，還有500多億元的減幅空間，融資減肥也有利盤勢；此外，持續觀察外資何時在台股現貨市場回補訊號。

台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金經理人沈建宏表示，展望台股後市，長線AI趨勢並未改變，技術面拉回、籌碼有效沉澱，有助台股長期表現，長線無須悲觀。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 日股狂瀉「血流成河」　AI泡沫疑慮引爆賣壓
news.Content:
（中央社記者戴雅真東京2026年11月6日專電）日本股市今天出現恐慌性賣壓，日經平均指數盤中一度暴跌超過4300點，跌破5萬7000點，創下約半年來首度跌破6萬點大關的紀錄。社群媒體上「股市暴跌」登上熱門話題，不少日本網友哀號「血流成河」。

面對股市暴跌，日本首相高市早苗在國會接受質詢時坦言，「這波跌勢究竟會只是暫時性的，還是將持續一段時間，目前都無法預測。」高市也坦言，這波股市下跌以人工智慧（AI）及半導體相關類股最為明顯，相關股票確實出現相當大的跌幅。

她表示，日本政府將密切關注市場動向，不過股價終究由市場決定，因此不會特別發表評論。

集英社報導，這波股市暴跌的直接導火線來自美國。美股5日全面重挫，以科技股為主的那斯達克指數下跌5.52%，標準普爾500指數下跌4.36%，道瓊工業指數也下挫3.44%。

其中，費城半導體指數更暴跌超過12%，AI晶片龍頭輝達（NVIDIA）下跌逾9%，超微（AMD）則重挫超過17%，顯示過去支撐美股上漲的AI概念股，正面臨投資人大舉撤出資金。

美股賣壓也迅速蔓延至亞洲。日本半導體設備大廠愛德萬測試、東京威力科創，以及積極布局AI投資的軟銀集團，股價紛紛遭到拋售。韓國綜合股價指數KOSPI也暴跌超過8%，甚至觸發暫停交易的熔斷機制，顯示全球市場正同步重新評估AI相關企業的投資價值。

值得注意的是，日本股市原本的跌勢主要集中在AI相關類股。日經平均指數昨天下跌1.79%，但反映日本整體股市表現的東證股價指數TOPIX反而上漲1.16%，東京證交所Prime市場更有超過7成個股收紅，顯示當時並非全面性股災。

然而到了今天，賣壓已擴散至其他產業，市場開始擔憂，AI類股修正可能演變成更廣泛的股市下跌。

市場分析指出，這波跌勢背後的核心問題，是投資人開始質疑AI產業龐大資本支出的獲利能力。

近年來，美國大型科技企業投入巨額資金興建資料中心、採購高效能晶片，帶動半導體及相關設備需求暴增，也推升AI概念股股價。不過，隨著投資規模持續擴大，市場開始擔憂，這些支出究竟何時能轉化為實際獲利，一旦AI需求成長不如預期，過去被高度期待的企業估值就可能面臨大幅修正。

除了AI投資過熱疑慮，美國的期中選舉也為市場增添不確定性。民主黨在選舉中奪回國會參眾兩院多數席次，並在州長選舉取得進展。

市場擔憂，民主黨勢力擴大後，可能推動更嚴格的AI資料中心監管政策。由於大型資料中心耗費大量電力及水資源，美國部分地區已因電價上漲、環境衝擊及噪音問題，出現反對興建資料中心的聲浪。德州更由主張停止新建資料中心的民主黨候選人贏得州長選舉，進一步引發投資人對未來AI基礎建設可能受到限制的疑慮。

儘管相關監管措施尚未確定，但如果資料中心建設進度放緩，恐將連帶影響半導體、電力設備及相關供應鏈的需求，成為市場提前反映的風險。

news.Title: 台股史詩級暴跌後拉升，聯發科、大立光率先展現抗跌力
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】亞股陷入恐慌性殺盤，台股週五跳空暴跌，盤中摜破年線，最低下探37,837.05點，單日最大跌點達3,737.67點，改寫歷史紀錄。不過，隨後指數逐步收斂跌幅，並重新站回年線之上，終場以39,701.64點作收，下跌1,873.08點，跌幅4.51%，成交量則急遽放大至1.24兆元。　　值得注意的是，週五早盤大型權值股賣壓沉重，尤其台積電(2330)、聯發科(2454)及台達電(2308)等重量級個股，開盤即遭摜至跌停。然而，台積電跌停開出後，隨即展開緩步反攻，顯示當市場連台積電都出現跌停時，恐慌性賣壓可能已達一定程度，也意味著大盤逐漸進入相對低檔區。

聯發科則在上午9點半之後打開跌停，隨即展開反攻，盤中甚至一度由黑翻紅、站上平盤，儘管終場仍下跌70元，但跌停賣壓獲得消化，顯示股價下檔支撐開始轉強。台達電隨後也打開跌停，但反攻力道相對有限；大立光(3008)則從跌停價一路拉升，盤中一度攻上平盤，終場下跌45元，以4,480元作收，同樣開始展現低檔抵抗力道。

雖然台股經過連續重挫後，週五跌幅已明顯收斂，但這並不代表大盤立即就能展開強勁反攻，後續仍不排除再度回測低點、形成第二隻腳。惟從權值股盤中表現來看，聯發科與大立光在恐慌賣壓中展現相對強勢的反攻力道，已逐漸具備多頭指標的特徵，後續能否延續止跌回穩態勢，將是觀察台股築底與反攻的重要指標。

news.Title: 台股失守4萬點　電信生技自行車抗跌成資金避風港
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年11月6日電）台股今天出現恐慌性殺盤，早盤崩跌3737.67點，終場以下跌1873.08點作收，失守4萬點大關。但重挫吸引中長線買盤進場，大型權值股大立光、聯發科相對抗跌，電信股、記憶體模組、生技、資安及自行車族群未受AI風暴波及，今天成為資金避風港。

美股費城半導體指數重挫，韓國股市早盤熔斷，日股大跌，台股早盤一度崩跌3737.67點，失守年線38834點，創盤中最大跌點；終場下跌1873.08點，收在39701.64點，失守4萬點大關。

AI股重挫，但台股盤面並非全面走跌，大型權值股方面，聯發科收跌2%左右，大立光跌幅1%以內；記憶體族群中，南亞科、華邦電跌幅約在5%，模組廠威剛平盤作收，十銓收漲逾2%，宇瞻收漲近5%。

生技股由藥華藥領軍，收漲逾7%；泰福-KY、保瑞、視陽漲約3%，漢達上漲3.98%。自行車族群巨大及美利達以紅盤作收，製鞋股來億-KY上漲2.8%。

電信股再度成為台股資金避風港，中華電信收紅漲逾1%，股價以163.5元再創收盤歷史新高；台灣大上漲0.5元，遠傳跌幅0.5%以內。

隨著AI應用普及、企業數位轉型及資安威脅增加，資安產業長期需求受到關注，吸引資金進駐，精誠大漲8.78%，安碁資訊、中華資安、伊雲谷、華經等收紅。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 韓股暴跌擋不住 政府緊急暫停140%融資維持率規定 以防「斷頭潮」
news.Content:
為遏止因股價下跌所引發的股票強制平倉(斷頭)惡性循環，南韓政府宣布自11月9日起，暫停實施證券商融資擔保維持率140%的法定要求，為期3個月。

這項緊急穩定措施是在南韓副總理兼企劃財政部長李亨日(Lee Hyoung-il)主持的跨部會市場狀況檢查會議中研商定案。出席會議的官員包括金融委員會委員長李億源、金融監督院長李燦鎮及南韓央行副總裁權敏秀等財經高層。

韓股周五(6日)遭遇劇烈賣壓，綜合股價指數(KOSPI)一度大跌逾8.7%並跌破5000點大關，創下九個月以來新低，同時觸發20分鐘的熔斷機制暫停交易。

針對近期市場動盪，財政部長李亨日引述政府評估指出，本次股市回檔主要是受到美國期中選舉後對人工智慧(AI)資料中心法規疑慮、AI投資回報擔憂，以及全球投資人避險情緒加劇所致。他強調，南韓經濟基本面依然堅實，預計今年經濟成長率將達3%中段，出口額可突破1兆美元，企業營業利潤上看900兆韓元。李亨日呼籲投資人切勿因市場過度焦慮而過度悲觀。

根據現行法規，證券商辦理融資業務時須維持至少140%的擔保比率；若股價暴跌導致擔保價值不足，券商便會要求投資人補繳保證金，否則將實施強制處分。本次放寬規定後，各券商將可根據市場情況彈性調整維持率或延後處分時間，大幅減輕市場的連續斷頭賣壓。

市場對此措施反應不一。社群市場觀察者CuteICP6233表示，樂見當局迅速放寬融資維持率規定，此舉能有效紓解連鎖斷頭的壓力，但他也指出減輕斷頭壓力與買盤動能重新注入仍有不同，短期內對於快速反彈持謹慎態度。

財經當局表示，將持續即時監控股市、外匯與債券市場，若市場波動進一步擴大，已準備好隨時推動追加的市場穩定措施。

news.Title: 史上第四慘！台股收盤下殺1873點 上市櫃18檔逆勢漲停
news.Content:
由於勝選的民主黨打算加強控制人工智慧產業發展的力道，引發股市出現恐慌性賣壓，台股今（6日）早盤一度下殺3737點創下史上最大跌點，觸及37837.05點，包含台積電與聯發科在內的上市櫃500家企業跌停，台股跌深後出現承接力道跌點快速收斂千點，終場台股重挫1873.08點，創下史上第四大跌點，收在39701.64點，爆出1.24兆元成交量。

台積電、聯發科、台達電及日月光等大型權值股一度被殺至跌停，但在日韓股跌幅收斂後，台股也有所抬升，大幅收斂超過2千點，「第四法人」散戶出現逢低進場買盤，00685L群益台灣加權正二ETF高居成交量排行第一，元大台灣50正二ETF也衝上第三名。

終場，台積電下跌105元收在2135元，聯發科跌70元收在3390元，台達電跌75元收在1055元，日月光跌45元收在527元。生技醫療、太陽能及資安服務等3大族群逆勢上漲，百一、泓瀚、合邦、元晶、倚強科、樂意、力新、東友、廣寰科、欣厚KY、大拓KY、久昌、同亨、智聯服務、達能、勝昱、中茂及廣豐等上市櫃18檔漲停。

新台幣匯率一度貶破33元之後收斂，但仍站上32.9元關卡，後市仍要觀察外資是否持續匯出，以及國際股市是否消化利空，若能出現止跌力道，才有助於台股下周反彈。

永誠投顧分析師高碩亨於直播中指出，在新台幣止貶之前不要過度參與市場，等到止貶之後再買都還來得及，應該用「右側交易」的角度去觀察，不要一直想抄底。右側交易即等待股價止跌、上漲趨勢確認後才進場，順勢交易。

金管會預計下午宣布救市措施，外界預測祭出限空令，國安基金則喊話密切關注，必要時不排除召開國安基金管理委員會。

news.Title: 外資加碼日股、買超額"破兆"；日人大買海外股票
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-06 13:22:19 蔡承啟 發佈

外資持續加碼日股，週買超額連2週突破1兆日圓大關。而日本投資人(日人)大買海外股票，週買超額再度衝破1兆日圓、創今年來第4高水準。

日本財務省6日公佈統計數據指出，上週(10月25-31日)外資在日本股市買超1兆1,293億日圓，為連續第2週加碼日股，週買超額連2週衝破1兆日圓大關；2026年迄今(截至10月31日為止)外資買超日股的累計金額擴大至10兆9,015億日圓。

news.Title: Oracle vs. Alphabet: Which Is the Better AI Cloud Stock to Own for the Next 5 Years?
news.Content:
There's a growing list of technology companies investing heavily in artificial intelligence (AI) cloud computing as demand for compute capacity accelerates. Bank of America estimates that data center infrastructure spending will more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028.

But not every company that's spending money now on AI cloud computing will have substantial sales and earnings to show for it later.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG) and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) are two prominent cloud companies ramping up their AI investments right now. Still, while Alphabet's cloud sales are accelerating due to its spending, Oracle's debt is worrying shareholders.

Investors wondering which is the better AI cloud stock to own over the next five years need only look at Google Cloud's third-quarter sales doubling for their answer. Here's why Alphabet is the safer long-term bet.

Alphabet's AI spending is accelerating, but so is revenue

Alphabet stock fell hard recently amid investor concerns about its high capital expenditures, which are expected to reach up to $205 billion this year. The spending has resulted in $9.1 billion in negative free cash flow, worrying many Alphabet shareholders.

But investors seemed to misunderstand two factors: First, $5.1 billion of the negative free cash flow was from a one-time fee to the European Commission, making the decline not as bad as it first appears. The second is that Alphabet's AI spending already appears to be paying off amid rising Google Cloud sales.

Consider that Google Cloud sales more than doubled in the third quarter (which ended Sept. 30) to $30.7 billion. That's an exceptionally high growth rate and shows why the company's capex is rising so quickly.

Rising demand for computing capacity is encouraging Alphabet to ramp up spending, and as expensive as it is, demand appears to continue outpacing capacity. The company said Google Cloud has a $561 billion cloud backlog, which it estimates will convert to sales over the next 24 months.

Negative free cash flow isn't great to see, I'll admit. But the company can always pull back spending once it has enough compute capacity. And when it does, its soaring cloud sales will likely help bring the company's free cash flow back into positive territory -- especially considering that Google Cloud's operating income recently tripled to $11 billion and operating margins have increased to 36%.

Story Continues

Oracle is making a riskier AI bet

Oracle is also investing heavily in data center infrastructure, with management saying that capital expenditures will total up to $95 billion this year. That's up from $55.7 billion in fiscal 2026.

Investors have been skeptical about Oracle's accelerating spending, and they really haven't liked how the company is paying for it by taking on debt. To ease concerns, leadership recently said it would limit its capital raises through fiscal 2030 to an additional $20 billion (on top of an additional $20 billion raised recently).

While that temporarily eased investor fears, they came roaring back just days later when Oracle announced it would raise all of that $20 billion immediately rather than over the next few years. Oracle has about $169 billion in total debt, which has spooked investors and resulted in Oracle's stock falling 50% over the past year.

It may not be all bad news for Oracle investors, though, as management says free cash flow could be $30 billion or more in fiscal 2029 -- a stark contrast to its negative free cash flow of $23.7 billion in fiscal 2026.

If you feel comfortable with some additional risk, Oracle stock could be a good investment as the company's spending slows and free cash flow rebounds over the next couple of years.

But I think Alphabet looks like the better AI cloud stock over the next five years. It's already the third-largest cloud player and is poised to generate significant sales from its massive Google Cloud backlog.

news.Title: 美民主黨期中選舉大勝衝擊AI股　日股暴跌逾3200點
news.Content:
（中央社記者戴雅真東京2026年11月6日專電）美國民主黨在期中選舉大勝，市場擔心未來AI產業將面臨更嚴格的監管，引發全球科技股拋售潮。日本股市今天受到衝擊，日經平均指數上午收盤暴跌3219點，跌幅達5.27%，收在57858點，盤中跌點一度超過4300點，約半年來首度跌破6萬點大關。

日本經濟新聞報導，這波跌勢從美國一路蔓延到亞洲。美股5日科技股全面走低，費城半導體指數重挫12.24%。亞洲股市今天開盤後也難逃賣壓，韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）盤中跌幅一度超過8%，觸發暫停交易的熔斷機制，台灣加權股價指數同樣大跌。

日本股市更是全面潰敗，東京證交所Prime市場上午收盤時，高達98%的股票下跌。

其中，AI及半導體相關企業首當其衝，愛德萬測試、軟銀集團盤中一度暴跌16%，記憶體大廠鎧俠也重挫15%。光纖大廠藤倉跌幅更一度達20%，吐回今年上半年所有漲幅，賣壓甚至擴散到豐田汽車等非AI相關企業。

市場這次恐慌，主要來自美國政治風向轉變。民主黨被認為對AI監管態度較為積極，這次不僅在期中選舉取得壓倒性勝利，也拿下德州、俄亥俄州等多個規劃興建大型資料中心的州長選舉。投資人擔心，未來地方政府可能暫停或限制資料中心建設，進一步拖慢AI產業投資腳步。

市場不安情緒也波及AI企業上市計畫。路透社6日報導，預計11月下旬上市的美國AI新創公司Anthropic，原定下週舉行的投資人說明會能否順利進行，已開始受到質疑。市場擔心上市計畫可能延後，進一步打擊投資信心。

面對AI產業前景出現變數，部分投資機構已提前減碼。日本Commons投信社長伊井哲朗透露，早在10月美國科技企業信用疑慮浮現時，就已賣出部分AI及半導體股票，增加手中現金。

伊井認為，民主黨勝選幅度超出市場預期，未來AI投資放慢恐怕難以避免，而且這波股市下跌可能還沒結束，真正的恐慌性拋售高峰仍在後頭。

不過，市場也有分析認為，AI技術長期發展的趨勢並未改變，這波股災更像是過去資金過度集中在AI及半導體股票，如今開始大舉撤出的結果。AI熱潮未必就此結束，但隨著美國政治風向改變，相關企業接下來恐怕得面對一段艱難的調整期。

news.Title: What NerdWallet (NRDS) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in NerdWallet, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

Q3 revenue rose 11% to $240 million but missed guidance of $244 million to $260 million, as a $17 million drop in auto insurance revenue offset growth in lending and deposit products. NerdWallet said it does not expect to resolve its auto insurance partnership gap in Q4.

Consumer revenue increased 12% to $215 million, while small- and midsize-business revenue rose 6% to $25 million. Declining organic search traffic, including from AI summaries in Google results, continues to pressure parts of the business.

NerdWallet forecast Q4 revenue of $191 million to $203 million and expects full-year revenue growth, while planning increased investment in AI and vertically integrated businesses. Trailing-12-month adjusted free cash flow rose 51% to $129 million; the company repurchased about $11 million of stock in Q3.

MarketBeat Week in Review – 04/27 - 05/01

NerdWallet (NASDAQ:NRDS) reported third-quarter revenue of $240 million, up 11% from a year earlier but below its guidance range, as a $17 million decline in auto insurance revenue offset growth in several lending and deposit products.

CEO Tim Chen said the company's relatively narrow network of auto insurance carriers limited its ability to monetize traffic as more insurers became competitive in acquiring customers. NerdWallet does not expect to resolve the issue in the fourth quarter.

→ Apple's Earnings Beat Comes With a Catch for Investors Heading Into the Holidays

NerdWallet's Growth Story Looks Strong—But Can It Last?

"We were overly optimistic on partnership timelines," Chen said, adding that the company is working to expand its relationships with insurance carriers and third-party agents.

Consumer Growth Offset by Insurance Decline

Third-quarter revenue fell short of NerdWallet's forecast range of $244 million to $260 million. Consumer revenue rose 12% to $215 million, driven by student loans, personal loans and deposit accounts, CFO John Lee said.

→ Are the Fears Around Alphabet's Search Slowdown Warranted?

NerdWallet Climbs 71% In February On Upbeat Full-Year Guidance

Personal loan revenue benefited from an expanded marketplace serving more borrowers, while deposit account growth reflected increased partner budgets. Those gains were partially offset by the decline in auto insurance revenue.

Small and midsize business revenue rose 6% to $25 million, supported by loan originations and renewals. Lee said organic search traffic continued to pressure other products in that segment.

Story Continues

→ Palantir's $2.3 Billion Quarter Puts Its Premium Valuation to the Test

GAAP operating income was $19 million. Non-GAAP operating income was $30 million, at the low end of guidance, representing a 13% margin. Adjusted EBITDA was $40 million, with a 17% margin.

Beginning in the third quarter, NerdWallet changed its definition of non-GAAP operating income to exclude certain accelerated stock-based compensation. Lee said the change resulted in a $3.9 million add-back in the quarter related to a previous acquisition.

Insurance Partnerships Remain a Priority

Chen said NerdWallet has direct relationships with a few of the top 10 auto insurance carriers. One had been particularly competitive in acquiring customers during 2024 and 2025, but other major carriers have become more aggressive this year, he said.

Building direct carrier relationships can take quarters, even after a company establishes sufficient volume or a market reputation, Chen said. He added that NerdWallet has the volume and is holding discussions, but the timing of new partnerships remains difficult to predict.

"We don't expect to resolve the problem in Q4," Chen said.

Search and AI Strategy

Chen said organic search traffic has declined rapidly over the past three and a half years, though the pace of declines has stabilized somewhat in recent months. Educational content has been severely affected as Google places AI summaries in search results, he said, while product marketplaces have been more insulated because they involve inventory, pricing and eligibility information.

Lee described NerdWallet's business as comprising its declining SEO-led content operation, a growing paid marketing marketplace, vertical integration investments and longer-term AI-related projects. The AI projects are not contributing to revenue today but are affecting operating expenses, he said.

Chen said the company is using AI-assisted development to improve software for its in-house agents and is exploring how licensed agents could support consumers shopping through AI assistants. He cautioned that the potential size of AI-driven traffic is difficult to predict and could vary by product category.

In auto insurance, participation by major carriers could depend on concerns including customer churn and the cost of providing quotes, Chen said.

Outlook and Capital Returns

NerdWallet forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $191 million to $203 million and non-GAAP operating income of $9 million to $15 million. For the full year, it expects non-GAAP operating income of $85 million to $91 million.

The full-year outlook includes a $15 million to $20 million negative impact from investments in vertically integrated brokering and advisory businesses, consistent with the prior quarter's outlook. Lee said NerdWallet plans to increase spending on longer-payback vertical integration and AI projects in 2027, which will weigh on non-GAAP operating income in the near term.

Although planning for 2027 is ongoing, Lee said the company expects full-year revenue growth, while growth in the first quarter will be challenging because of the comparison with the prior year.

NerdWallet generated $129 million in adjusted free cash flow over the trailing 12 months, up 51% year over year. It repurchased approximately $11 million of Class A common stock during the third quarter and had about $57 million remaining under its repurchase authorization as of September 30.

About NerdWallet (NASDAQ:NRDS)

NerdWallet, Inc is a personal finance company that operates a digital platform designed to help consumers make informed financial decisions. Its website and mobile tools provide educational content, personalized recommendations and comparison services across a range of financial products.

The company covers categories including credit cards, banking, personal and student loans, mortgages, insurance, investing and small-business finance. NerdWallet generates revenue primarily through partnerships with financial institutions and other providers when users engage with or apply for recommended products.

Founded in 2009 by Tim Chen and Jacob Gibson, NerdWallet is headquartered in San Francisco and serves consumers primarily in the United States.

news.Title: Microchip Technology Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Microchip Technology Incorporated? Here are five stocks we like better.

September-quarter revenue rose 42.2% year over year to $1.622 billion , while adjusted earnings reached $0.97 per share, beating the guidance midpoint. Industrial sales grew 50.3% and data center sales 55.7% year over year.

Microchip forecast December-quarter revenue ranging from a 3% decline to 1% growth sequentially, as extended supply lead times prevent it from filling some orders. Orders exceeded shipments, and management said the March-quarter backlog is stronger than December's was at the same point.

Data center revenue topped $250 million, with the company targeting $1 billion for calendar 2026. Microchip generated $377.1 million in adjusted free cash flow and plans to prioritize debt reduction while keeping its dividend unchanged for now.

Analog Devices Shows Why AI Is Not the Only Story Driving Chip Demand

Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) reported a 42.2% increase in fiscal second-quarter revenue, but forecast a slight sequential decline for the December quarter as supply constraints delay shipments of some high-margin products.

The chipmaker said demand remained strong across its business, with industrial and data center sales leading growth. President and CEO Steve Sanghi said orders exceeded shipments in the September quarter and that the company entered the December quarter with a higher backlog.

→ Apple's Earnings Beat Comes With a Catch for Investors Heading Into the Holidays

AI Is Reviving an Overlooked Chip Category—and These 3 Names Are Riding the Demand Wave

Revenue for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026, rose to $1.622 billion, up 9.2% from the June quarter. Adjusted earnings were $0.97 per diluted share, $0.04 above the midpoint of the company's guidance. GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders was $373.6 million, or $0.68 per share, including a $0.13-per-share tax benefit.

One-Time Items Boosted September Results

CFO Eric Bjornholt said approximately $53 million of infrequent items boosted September-quarter revenue and would not recur in the December quarter. Those items consisted of a $21 million effect from a pricing change on inventory in the distribution channel, $22 million of licensing revenue above the amount expected in December, and a $10 million benefit from a long-term customer contract.

→ Are the Fears Around Alphabet's Search Slowdown Warranted?

Microchip Technology Says the Slump Is Ending—The Stock Is Starting to Agree

All three items carried 100% gross margins, Bjornholt said. Overall non-GAAP gross margin was 66.5%, including $26.6 million in capacity underutilization charges. Sanghi said the company's revenue upside relative to its prior guidance came from product sales, rather than the infrequent items, which had been included in its forecast.

Story Continues

Industrial sales grew 50.3% year over year and represented 34.6% of revenue excluding licensing. Data center sales rose 55.7% and accounted for 16.7%. Aerospace and defense grew 41%, while automotive increased 19.3%. Compute was the only listed end market to decline, falling 1.6%.

Supply Constraints Shape December Outlook

→ Amazon Has Erased Its Earnings Sell-Off, But Is the Biggest Opportunity Still Ahead?

Microchip expects December-quarter revenue to range from down 3% to up 1% sequentially. At the midpoint, revenue would be up 35.4% from a year earlier. The forecast includes approximately $4 million in sales from recently acquired AI-on-the-edge business Hailo and $6 million from aerospace and defense acquisition VORAGO.

The company projected non-GAAP gross margin of 64% to 65% and adjusted diluted earnings of $0.87 to $0.95 per share. Sanghi said the December quarter is typically down 3% to 5% sequentially because of seasonal factors.

Supply limitations are also holding back the outlook. Sanghi said lead times across product lines now range from six to 32 weeks, compared with a historical four to eight weeks for most standard products. Constraints at foundries, outsourced assembly and test suppliers, and some internal operations have left the company unable to fill some orders within the quarter.

"The backlog for March quarter today is much better than December quarter was at the same point in time," Sanghi said. He said he was hopeful March would be stronger but did not provide formal guidance.

Bjornholt said Microchip does not expect a material change in overall underutilization charges in December: wafer-fabrication utilization is improving, but the company is slowing some assembly and test operations after building finished-goods inventory in September.

Data Center Wins and Pricing Pressure

Data center revenue exceeded $250 million in the September quarter and is on track to reach $1 billion in calendar 2026, Sanghi said. Microchip had 24 combined design wins for its Gen 6 PCIe switches and retimers as of the call, up from 19 at the end of September. Sanghi said the company could not assign a dollar value to those wins, but expects nearly all 24 designs to be in production by the start of 2028.

Sanghi argued that AI-related demand has crowded out capacity at suppliers and described the data center market as being "in the bubble." He said a slowdown could free capacity for Microchip's broader business, though he acknowledged volumes from the new Gen 6 design wins could be lower if data center demand slows.

Microchip also faces another round of supplier price increases starting in January. Sanghi said the company currently plans to absorb the higher costs rather than quickly raise customer prices again. Management maintained its long-term non-GAAP gross-margin target of 65%.

Debt Reduction Remains the Priority

Microchip generated $419.2 million in operating cash flow and $377.1 million in adjusted free cash flow during the September quarter. Its net debt-to-adjusted EBITDA ratio was 2.36 at quarter-end.

Bjornholt said the board wants to continue reducing leverage and expects to keep the dividend unchanged for now. The company will likely revisit the broader question of cash returns to investors as it moves into the next fiscal year, he said.

About Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP)

Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) develops and manufactures semiconductor products used in embedded control and connected electronic systems. Its portfolio includes microcontrollers, microprocessors, analog and power-management devices, memory products, timing and connectivity components, security solutions, and field-programmable gate arrays. The company also provides development tools, software, evaluation kits, and technical support to help customers design and produce electronic equipment.

Microchip's products are used across a range of markets, including automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, communications, consumer electronics, data centers, and medical applications.

news.Title: 韓股波動加劇！韓國政府放寬融資規則，防堵追繳賣壓引發強制拋售
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，韓國將放寬融資(Margin Loan)規則以遏制股市波動。韓國政府發表聯合聲明稱，將暫時豁免證券公司必須持有價值至少相當於其保證金貸款140%的抵押品的規定，此舉旨在防止強制拋售加劇股市波動。

該豁免期將從11月9日起持續三個月。

韓國有關當局一致認為，韓國股市對外部因素反應過度，這些外部因素包括人工智能政策的不確定性以及全球投資情緒的疲軟。

有關當局將以最高級別的警惕性即時監測國內外股票市場和資金流動，並積極因應，防止市場進一步動盪。如果市場波動進一步加劇，政府將準備額外的市場穩定措施。

news.Title: AI泡沫疑慮引爆全球賣壓　日韓股市同步重挫
news.Content:
（中央社東京2026年11月6日綜合外電報導）美股人工智慧（AI）相關股票遭大規模拋售後，亞洲股市今天普遍下跌。日股基準指數開市後暴跌逾6%，其他亞洲主要股市也走低。

美聯社報導，東京日經225指數早盤下跌6.2%報57271.19點；韓股Kospi指數下跌7.1%報5000.25點；澳洲S&P/ASX 200指數下跌0.7%報9003.40點。

全球股市持續承受壓力，主要受到先前受惠AI產業熱潮的企業股價續跌的影響。由於借貸成本高昂，市場擔心AI資料中心建設可能減緩，相關股票數個月來持續大幅波動。批評者也指出，AI股票價格已被炒得過高，形成泡沫。

華爾街股市標準普爾500指數收跌4.4%，創2025年4月美國總統川普推出「解放日」關稅政策、震撼全球市場以來的最大單日跌幅。

道瓊工業指數暴跌1833點，跌幅3.4%；以AI及其他科技股為主的那斯達克指數重挫5.5%，較上個月創下的歷史高點累跌11.9%。

美國期中選舉民主黨在全國各地取得勝利，提高了政府可能要求暫停更多資料中心建設的可能性。不同政治立場的選民對AI抱持戒心，也不滿資料中心導致電費上漲。

如果AI資料中心建設放緩，意味著AI晶片採購量將減少，電力以及其他在AI熱潮中需求大增的產品與服務也將受到影響。

輝達（Nvidia）是迅速成為AI熱潮代表的晶片製造商，股價收跌9.3%，也是拖累標普500指數最重的個股。輝達今年迄今累跌2.6%。在此之的前3年，年度漲幅分別約39%、171%及239%。

超微（AMD）股價暴跌17.3%，透過雲端向客戶出租AI晶片運算資源的CoreWeave，下跌9.8%；為資料中心提供電力設備的GE Vernova下跌7.5%。

若從長期來看，股價通常隨著企業獲利及利率走勢而變動，這些因素對股市的影響，遠大於華府由哪個政黨掌握政權。

在能源交易方面，美國基準原油價格上漲0.60%，每桶報91.06美元；國際基準布倫特原油價格上漲3.88%，每桶報98.29美元。

伊朗戰爭接下來將如何發展，以及全球能源產業何時能恢復正常，目前仍充滿不確定性。

10年期美國公債殖利率降至4.84%，美國大選當晚，這項公債殖利率曾達4.95%，上個月更一度高於5.30%。

這可能顯示，隨著股價暴跌，投資人正大量轉向美國公債，希望尋找相對安全的投資標的。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】政院宣示穩定股市　台股跌幅收斂重回4萬點大關
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年11月6日電）美國期中選舉結果衝擊人工智慧（AI）資料中心政策進展，美股重挫，台股早盤一度崩跌3737.67點，創歷史盤中最大跌點，摜破4萬點大關並失守年線，上市櫃跌停家數一度超過500家；在政院宣示穩定股市後，指數跌幅明顯收斂，於40000點大關震盪。

面對台股早盤重挫，行政院長卓榮泰上午表示，已指示金管會密切關切國際及國內股市變化情形，隨時機動性決定穩定股市。

盤中包括台積電、聯發科、鴻海、日月光投控、南亞科、聯電等電子權值股陸續打開跌停，被動元件大廠國巨、塑化股南亞、光電族群等跌幅逐步收斂，台股跌點縮小至1500點內，低檔拉升超過2300點，重返4萬點整數關卡，收復年線約38837點。

到10時50分，加權指數40276.56點，下跌1298.16點，跌幅3.12%，成交值放大至新台幣7584.4億元；電子指數挫跌3.42%，金融指數下跌3.16%，代表中小型股的櫃買OTC指數下挫4.62%。

台股權值龍頭台積電開盤後觸及跌停2020元，大跌220元，創史上盤中最大跌點，市值一度蒸發5.7兆元，盤中跌點收斂，下跌60元至2180元，跌2.68%。主要電子權值股聯發科跌幅收斂至1.5%，日月光投控跌幅約4.3%，鴻海下跌3.4%，台達電打開跌停下跌約6.6%，記憶體廠南亞科跌幅收斂至1.1%，國巨收斂至6%。

不過，中小型電子股成為重災區，股價超過千元的高價股綠油油，股王信驊、股后川湖亮燈鎖跌停，生技股藥華藥逆勢勁揚逾7%，高價股降至「37千金」。

中國信託證券投顧總經理陳柏州接受記者電訪指出，台股早盤重挫主要反映美股費城半導體指數崩跌影響，台積電跌停後打開，後續觀察台積電跌幅可否進一步收斂，代表長線買盤資金陸續進駐，有利盤勢止穩；也一需觀察上市櫃跌停家數可否減少，避免流動性問題。

展望台股後市，陳柏州指出，預期今天融資餘額可大幅減肥，有助盤勢加速趕底，後續留意金融股表現，觀察市場投資氛圍。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: Tower Semiconductor Ltd (TSEM) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Revenue of $526 Million ...
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Revenue: Q3 2026 record revenue of $526 million, up 36% year-over-year from $396 million and 14% quarter-over-quarter from $460 million.

Gross Profit: Record $179 million in Q3 2026, up 92% year-over-year from $93 million.

Operating Profit: $127 million in Q3 2026, 2.5x the operating profit in Q3 2025.

Net Profit: $120 million in Q3 2026, representing a 23% net margin, more than double the $54 million (14% margin) in Q3 2025.

Earnings Per Share: $1.06 basic and $1.05 diluted in Q3 2026, versus $0.48 basic and $0.47 diluted in Q3 2025.

Silicon Photonics Revenue: Approximately $240 million contributed in Q3 2026; Q4 2026 annualized run rate expected to exceed $1.1 billion.

BCD Revenue: About 10% year-over-year growth across 200mm and 300mm platforms; forecasted 20% higher blended prices for 2027 versus 2026.

Q4 2026 Guidance: Mid-range revenue guidance of $600 million; full-year 2026 revenue of $2 billion versus $1.57 billion in 2025.

Balance Sheet: Total assets of $4 billion (including $1.8 billion net fixed assets and $2 billion current assets); record shareholders' equity of $3.2 billion (80% of total assets); current ratio of ~3.7x.

CapEx: $920 million SiPho and SiGe investment plan, ~65% paid to date with remaining 35% expected in Q4 2026 and H1 2027; expected full ROI within one year.

Customer Pre-payments: SiPho customer pre-payments (mostly toward 2027 capacity reservation), including $290 million received in Q1 2026, recorded as operating cash flow.

Utilization: All 200mm fabs at 85%90%; 300mm 12-inch fab fully utilized above the 85% model.

Updated Business Model Targets: $3.6 billion annual revenue, $1.63 billion gross profit (45% margin), $1.38 billion operating profit (38% margin), and $1.2 billion net profit (33% margin).

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 2 Warning Signs with TSEM.

Is TSEM fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Release Date: November 02, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

Tower Semiconductor Ltd ( NASDAQ:TSEM ) reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $526 million, up 33% year-over-year, with net profit of $120 million (23% net margin) versus $54 million (14% margin) a year ago.

Silicon Photonics revenue reached approximately $240 million in Q3 2026, and the company expects to double capacity by year-end, targeting a $1.1 billion annualized run rate in Q4 2026 and a $2.8-$2.9 billion SiPho run rate by Q3 2027.

Tower Semiconductor Ltd ( NASDAQ:TSEM ) has secured customer demand commitments through 2029 for both 200mm and 300mm production, providing strong long-term revenue visibility and supporting a $3.6 billion annual revenue target with 45% gross margin and 33% net margin.

The $920 million CapEx investment is progressing ahead of schedule, with 65% already paid, and is expected to achieve full ROI within one year, funded by customer pre-payments and long-term agreements.

Tower Semiconductor Ltd ( NASDAQ:TSEM ) is expanding its served market through advanced technologies like NPO (near-packaged optics), integrated lasers, and 300mm expansion, with prototyping engagements with over 10 top customers and potential to double the optical transceiver market.

Story Continues

Negative Points

Tower Semiconductor Ltd ( NASDAQ:TSEM ) faces increasing competition in Silicon Photonics and Silicon Germanium, with a major competitor ramping capacity, which could pressure market share and pricing despite the company's leadership position.

The company's long-term financial model relies on aggressive assumptions, including all fabs operating at 85% utilization post-expansion, which may be challenging to sustain amid market fluctuations and potential seasonality.

Incremental gross margins are expected to decline from the 62% seen in Q3 2026 to a range of 55-58% as additional depreciation from new tools kicks in, potentially impacting near-term profitability growth.

RF mobile revenue is approaching a trough in the low 50s (as a percentage of total revenue), with a dip during the transition from Fab 7 to Fab 10, and the recovery trajectory remains uncertain despite expected growth in 2027.

The company's expansion plans, including Track-2 in Japan, are subject to execution risks and timing delays, with the full ramp of new capacity not expected until 2029, leaving potential for unforeseen challenges in construction and qualification.

Q & A Highlights

Q : Cody Acree of Benchmark asked CEO Russell Ellwanger to level-set the fiscal 2028 capacity support for SiPho and SiGe now that the $920 million CapEx program is ahead of schedule. A : Ellwanger declined to give an exact revenue target but framed it in capacity multiples: Q3 2026 SiPho revenue was $240 million, and Tower will exit Q4 with 2x the start capacity that drove that revenue, which becomes the run rate in Q2 2027. By Q3 2027, another 1x is added via Fab 7/Arai, tripling Q3 2026 shipments to roughly a $2.85 billion$2.9 billion SiPho run rate before integrated laser revenue, which sits on top of that. He also flagged a likely near-term announcement of further SiPho expansion at two 200-millimeter sites.

Q : Cody Acree asked whether the updated $3.6 billion revenue / $1.2 billion net profit business model may already be too conservative given the capacity math. A : Ellwanger declined to comment on it being conservative, calling it "an aggressive target," but added that Tower "wouldn't be giving a target to the Street that we don't have very, very high confidence that we will meet."

Q : Cody Acree asked CFO Oren Shirazi how sustainable the unusually high ~62% incremental gross margin was, and whether it is a new baseline. A : Shirazi said only about 65% of the $920 million in tools have started depreciating, with more depreciation coming from the remaining tranche and Track-1. He therefore reiterated the long-term model assumption of 55%58% incremental gross profit rather than the 65% seen this quarter.

Q : Vijay Rakesh of Mizuho asked how pricing and contracts are shaping up for newer NPO layouts, given multiple NPO versions, VCSELs and integrated lasers. A : Ellwanger said long-term contracts include pricing targets that set a floor, and that NPO resets the pricing curve higher than pluggables, consistent with a more advanced platform. He noted some competitors discount deeply because they cannot compete technically, and that Tower protects margins by being first to market with customers' next-generation applications.

Q : Vijay Rakesh asked whether NPO demand and backlog are shifting toward 3.2T / 400G-per-lane designs, and whether that is a higher-dollar, more complex SiPho layout. A : Ellwanger answered "yes" to both parts, confirming more 3.2T engagements and a higher-value mix.

Q : Simon Coles of Barclays asked for an update on the 12-inch (300-millimeter) SiPho ramp and how it helps Tower maintain leadership amid competition chatter. A : Ellwanger said 300-millimeter revenue volumes began shipping at extremely high yields, with best-in-class DMUX capability and strong insertion loss performance. Most NPO tape-outs are on 300-millimeter at 16 and 32 lanes. He said 300-millimeter capacity, about 10K in 200-millimeter equivalents in Q1, will triple by Q3 2027 and rise further in 2028, with a very large increase once the new shell is built at the end of 2028.

Q : Sahej Singh of Stifel asked whether the tripling of SiPho capacity by Q3 2027 is all Track-1 or includes remaining capacity from the $920 million program, and how many multiples Track-2 adds. A : Shirazi corrected the math: tripling $240 million gives a $720 million quarterly run rate, or about $2.8 billion annualized, not $960 million. Ellwanger added that Track-2 quadruples Fab 7's roughly 10,000 wafers per month of 300-millimeter capacity to about 40,000, which equates to close to 100,000 wafers in 200-millimeter equivalents given the ~2.25x die-size advantage of 300-millimeter.

Q : Sahej Singh asked about the timing of Track-2, noting Tower takes ownership of Fab 7 on April 1, and whether output could arrive in the second half of 2028. A : Ellwanger said Track-2 will be "well underway" in 2028 with building construction starting that year, and 2029 is when the capacity ramp lands coinciding with capacity contracts now being extended into 2029. He said acceleration by a quarter is a target but 2029 is the confident expectation.

Q : Bastien Faucon-Morin of Susquehanna asked how to think about SiPho and SiGe market share in 2027 given a major competitor's capacity ramp. A : President Marco Racanelli said market share is hard to pinpoint in a fast-growing market with room for multiple players, but Tower was first to ramp high-volume, high-yield 200-millimeter and then 300-millimeter SiPho, which underpins customer confidence to extend LTAs into 2029. Ellwanger added that billions of dollars of LTAs through 2029 reflect customer faith in Tower's execution and multi-generation road map, and that Q4 SiPho revenue is breaking a $1.1 billion annualized run rate.

Q : Bastien Faucon-Morin asked about the RF mobile trajectory into 2027, given tape-out activity and the business approaching a trough. A : Ellwanger said the trajectory is very strong after a dip from re-purposing Fab 7 toward optical and re-qualifying customers at Fab 10. He expects sequential growth with Q2 2027 setting absolute records, and teased an unreleased breakthrough figure of merit with at least one elite customer that opens a new market capability. Racanelli noted Tower focuses on the leading-edge "cream of the crop" segment of RFSOI, where capacity is limited.

Q : Richard Shannon of Craig-Hallum asked about the content uplift from laser integration/attach and what attach rates Tower expects over time. A : Ellwanger said integrated lasers open a new served market with appreciably higher ASPs, backed by strong customer forecasts not yet in the model. The die-to-wafer attach also covers indium phosphide 400G modulators and lithium niobate mod

news.Title: Switch 2銷量暴減4成 任天堂：目前沒考慮追加漲價
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-06 10:48:00 蔡承啟 發佈

今年度上半年(4-9月)Switch 2遊戲機全球銷售量暴減近4成，日本電玩大廠任天堂(Nintendo)財測遜色，今日股價暴跌。而任天堂表示，目前未考慮追加調漲Switch 2售價。

截至日本股市6日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)為止，任天堂暴跌7.55%，暫收8,210日圓。

任天堂5日於日股盤後公布今年度上半年(2026年4-9月)財報：因遊戲機銷量萎縮，拖累合併營收較去年同期減少12.1%至9,660億日圓，不過因遊戲軟體銷售穩健，加上美國關稅退款，合併營益暴增49.1%至2,165億日圓、合併純益成長11.0%至2,209億日圓。

任天堂指出，4-9月Switch 2全球銷售量較去年同期暴減37.4%至649萬台，Switch 2平台遊戲軟體銷售量成長18.8%至2,449萬套；Switch系列機種(一般版Switch+Switch Lite+OLED版Switch)全球銷售量暴減32.7%至127萬台，Switch平台遊戲軟體銷售量增加6.8%至6,573萬套。

任天堂維持今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)財測預估不變，合併營收預估將年減11.4%至2.05兆日圓、合併營益將年增2.7%至3,700億日圓、合併純益將年減26.9%至3,100億日圓。

金融情報服務公司QUICK事前所作的調查顯示，市場原先預期任天堂今年度營益、純益將為4,463億日圓、4,190億日圓。任天堂公佈的預估值遜於市場預期。

任天堂將今年度Switch 2全球銷售量目標維持於原先(8月)預估的1,650萬台不變、將年減16.9%，Switch也維持於原先預估的200萬台不變、將年減47.4%。

任天堂將今年度Switch 2平台遊戲軟體銷售量目標維持於原先預估的6,000萬套不變、將年增23.2%，Switch平台遊戲軟體也維持於原先預估的1億500萬套不變、將年減23.3%。

任天堂在今年5月將日本Switch 2售價調漲1萬日圓至5萬9,980日圓，並在9月將美國Switch 2售價調漲50美元至499.99美元、歐洲調漲30歐元至499.99歐元。

關於Switch 2是否將追加漲價，任天堂社長古川俊太郎在5日舉行的線上記者會上表示，「要先觀察價格調漲後的產品在今年年末旺季的銷售表現，再進行綜合性的評估。目前未考慮進一步調漲價格」。

古川俊太郎指出，「明年度(2027年度)記憶體等零組件價格飆漲的衝擊勢必會比今年度更大」。

AI伺服器用積層陶瓷電容(MLCC)需求旺，訂單飆增，BB值(接單出貨比)破紀錄，日本太陽誘電(Taiyo Yuden)再度上修財測，並加快擴產時程，計畫在明年度(2027年度)將AI伺服器用MLCC產能擴增至今年度(2026年度)的2倍以上。不過日本MLCC股今日股價暴跌。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間6日上午9點20分為止，太陽誘電重摔4.2%、MLCC龍頭廠村田製作所(Murata)崩跌9.90%、TDK崩跌8.48%。

太陽誘電5日於日股盤後公布財報新聞稿指出，因AI伺服器用MLCC需求旺，訂單飆增，今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)合併營收目標自原先(8月)預估的4,240億日圓上修至4,360億日圓(將年增22.7%)、合併營益目標自450億日圓上修至540億日圓(將年增170%)、合併純益目標自290億日圓上修至350億日圓(將年增136.4%)。此為太陽誘電繼8月之後、第2度上修今年度財測預估。

日媒報導，市場原先預期太陽誘電今年度純益將為304億日圓，太陽誘電上修過後的數值優於市場預期。

太陽誘電將今年度電容部門(MLCC部門)營收目標自原先預估的3,165億日圓上修至3,245億日圓、將年增28.9%。

太陽誘電指出，之前公布的中期(2026-2030年度)營運計劃啟動迄今已經過了半年，而因AI相關市場的成長速度遠高於制定計劃時的需求預估，因此決定將投資計劃提前2年執行，目標在2027年度將AI伺服器用MLCC產能擴增至今年度的2倍以上水準。

太陽誘電並同時公布上季(2026年7-9月)財報：因MLCC、電感銷量增加，稼動率(產能利用率)改善，合併營收較去年同期成長20.8%至1,121.36億日圓，合併營益飆增127.5%至133.78億日圓，合併純益因認列海外子公司訴訟相關損失而減少12.2%至56.31億日圓。

就部門別情況來看，上季太陽誘電電容部門(MLCC部門)營收較去年同期大增26.4%至833.14億日圓、電感部門營收成長13.0%至188.20億日圓、其他部門(包含鋁質電解電容、零件內藏式PCB、表面聲波濾波器SAW FILTER等產品)營收萎縮2.4%至100.02億日圓。

太陽誘電指出，上季(2026年7-9月)接獲的訂單金額較去年同期飆增130%至1,908億日圓，連續第4季呈現增長，季度別訂單額連續第3季衝破1,000億日圓大關，BB值(接單出貨比)為1.70，連續第4季突破顯示接單狀況是否活絡的界線「1」。

其中，太陽誘電上季電容部門(MLCC)訂單額飆增162%至1,524億日圓，連續第5季呈現增長，連續第2季衝破1,000億日圓大關，BB值為1.83、連續第4季突破「1」，BB值創開始公布季度別數據以來歷史新高紀錄。

上季太陽誘電MLCC設備稼動率為95%左右，10-12月以後預估將揚升至95%以上的高水準。

MLCC龍頭村田製作所10月30日宣布，為了因應MLCC中長期需求擴大，將在2026年度~2030年度的5年期間合計投資約1兆日圓，擴充MLCC產能，目標在2030年度將MLCC營收擴增至2025年度的2倍以上水準。

村田指出，因AI伺服器用電容(MLCC)需求強勁，上季(2026年7-9月)整體接獲的訂單額為7,534億日圓，較去年同期暴增54.7%，季度別訂單額創下歷史新高紀錄，其中電容訂單額飆增85.2%至4,479億日圓。

上季村田BB值為1.28，連續第8季高於顯示接單狀況是否活絡的界線「1」。

news.Title: Purple Innovation Inc (PRPL) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Cash Flow Turns Positive as ...
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Net Revenue: $96.5 million, down 19% year-over-year.

Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Revenue: $60.9 million, down 9% year-over-year; August and September combined up ~1% year-over-year.

E-commerce Revenue: $42.4 million, down 6% year-over-year; August and September combined up ~2% year-over-year, driven by Amazon and purple.com.

Showroom Revenue: $18.5 million, down 16% year-over-year; Q2+Q3 combined same-store comps down 1%, year-to-date showroom comps up nearly 2%.

Wholesale Revenue: $35.6 million, down 31% year-over-year; true channel performance down ~23% (accounting changes ~one quarter of decline).

Gross Profit: ~$41.9 million vs. $56.5 million prior year.

Gross Margin: 43.4%, down ~410 basis points year-over-year.

Operating Expenses: $51.7 million, down 25% year-over-year.

GAAP Net Loss: $1.4 million vs. $11.7 million net loss prior year.

Adjusted EBITDA: Loss of $0.5 million vs. positive $0.2 million prior year.

Cash and Cash Equivalents: $28.3 million at September 30, 2026, vs. $24.3 million at December 31, 2025.

Operating Cash Flow: Positive for third consecutive quarter; $10.6 million through first nine months of fiscal 2026, a $38.7 million improvement year-over-year.

Net Inventories: $53.5 million, down 10% from $59.7 million at December 31, 2025.

Capital Spending: $5.2 million in first nine months, supporting showroom expansion and manufacturing investments.

Showroom Count: 57 at quarter end; two opened in Q3 (San Antonio, Jacksonville), one in October (Cleveland); expected to end year with 60; targeting 912 new showrooms in 2027.

Release Date: November 04, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

Purple Innovation Inc ( NASDAQ:PRPL ) generated positive operating cash flow for the third consecutive quarter, with cash increasing to $28.3 million from $24.3 million at year-end 2025.

Direct-to-consumer trends improved in August and September, with combined net sales up approximately 1% year-over-year, driven by e-commerce growth at Amazon and purple.com.

Amazon significantly outperformed, supported by expanded Prime eligibility, improved fulfillment, inventory availability, and advertising efficiency.

Purple Innovation Inc ( NASDAQ:PRPL ) is launching its fullest product innovation pipeline, including new essentials and hybrid mattress collections representing nearly 90% of unit volume, with strong early retailer feedback.

Showroom expansion continues with 57 locations at quarter-end, plans to reach 60 by year-end, and a target of 9-12 new showrooms in 2027; year-to-date showroom comps are up nearly 2%.

Story Continues

Negative Points

Net revenue declined 19% year-over-year to $96.5 million, driven by significant weakness in wholesale.

Wholesale revenue plunged 31% year-over-year, with regional and independent retailers showing declines in sales velocity, distribution slots, and customers.

Gross margin fell approximately 410 basis points to 43.4% due to lower production leverage and inventory adjustments, pressuring profitability.

Full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance was lowered to $15-$20 million from the prior $20-$25 million outlook, reflecting continued volume deleverage.

Purple Innovation Inc ( NASDAQ:PRPL ) faces a debt maturity within six months and is still evaluating refinancing options and strategic alternatives, creating uncertainty.

Q & A Highlights

Q : How much of the wholesale weakness was industry-driven versus Purple-specific, and what is being done to fix it? A : CEO Robert Demartini acknowledged accountability on both fronts. The category remains weak (mid-to-high single digits and weakening), but he conceded Purple's product line is "a little tired," particularly with regional and independent wholesalers, as the company focused on other wholesale customers. Purple is accelerating innovation, increasing sales coverage, and improving training and support for these partners.

Q : What are the margin implications of the new product launches, and is there risk of trade-down or cannibalization from lower price points? A : The CEO stated the new line has no lower prices and won't carry further price increases given the June actions. Most of the margin pressure this quarter was cost absorption from lower volumes. The new products carry a similar margin profile to the old ones, but the volume energy they bring is expected to push margins back well north of 45% on a consistent basis.

Q : Is the wholesale pressure something new or an inflection point, or a long-standing issue that needs correcting? A : The CEO said it is not an inflection point but rather the result of focusing wholesale efforts on a couple of large customers over the last three quarters at the expense of regional independents. He also noted the June price increases were higher than he would have liked, and the consumer response in Julyespecially around July 4was "pretty negative." Demand has since returned in DTC, with August and September much stronger than July, though wholesale has been slower to recover.

Q : Are the price increases now complete, or is more pricing still working through the supply chain? A : CFO Robert Lucian said the company believes it is done with price increases while monitoring raw material costs. The mid-June pricing took effect immediately in DTC (showrooms and e-commerce), but it takes time to filter through to wholesale customers, so the full pricing was not reflected in Q3. That flow-through in Q4 is one reason gross margin is expected to improve.

Q : What parameters can be shared on the debt refinancing, given the maturity is roughly six months away? A : The CEO said there are multiple options being evaluated for which are best and attainable, and the company expects much more clarity on the path forward as the quarter unfolds and into the beginning of next year. He also noted the special committee continues to evaluate strategic alternatives and engage with interested parties that could provide Purple with scale and capital.

Q : What drove the third quarter revenue decline, and how did each channel perform? A : CFO Robert Lucian reported Q3 net revenue of $96.5 million, down 19% year over year, driven primarily by wholesale weakness. DTC revenue was $60.9 million (down 9%), with e-commerce at $42.4 million (down 6%) and showrooms at $18.5 million (down 16%). Wholesale revenue was $35.6 million, down 31%, with roughly one quarter of that decline due to accounting changes (about $4 million in reductions of revenue from certain payments to customers and a manufacturer under common control with a customer).

Q : How did DTC trends evolve through the quarter, and what is driving the improvement? A : The CEO said July and the July 4 period were weak as June price increases hit demand harder than anticipated, but business improved meaningfully from mid-August. August and September combined saw DTC net sales up approximately 1% year over year, with e-commerce up 2%, driven by growth at Amazon and Purple.com. Amazon outperformed on improved fulfillment, inventory availability, and advertising efficiency, while Purple.com conversion rates improved significantly year over year.

Q : What is the outlook for showrooms, given the 16% decline this quarter? A : The CEO attributed the decline to the prior-year Rejuvenate delivery shift inflating the comparison base and the June price increase. Looking at Q2 and Q3 together, showrooms were 2% below last year with same-store comps down only 1%, and year-to-date showroom comps are up nearly 2% when neutralizing the shipping change. Purple ended Q3 with 57 showrooms, expects 60 by year-end, and targets 9 to 12 new openings in 2027, with same-store comps expected to turn positive again in Q4.

Q : What is the updated full-year 2026 guidance? A : CFO Robert Lucian maintained full-year revenue guidance of $420 million to $440 million, reflecting a stronger Q4 on an improved marketing plan, normal DTC seasonality, and new product introductions, partially offset by continued wholesale pressure. Full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance was lowered to $15 million to $20 million from the prior $20 million to $25 million, reflecting continued volume deleverage in manufacturing operations.

Q : How is cash flow and the balance sheet trending? A : The CFO reported cash and equivalents of $28.3 million at September 30, 2026, up from $24.3 million at December 31, 2025. Operating cash flow was positive for the third consecutive quarter and totaled $10.6 million through the first nine months, a $38.7 million improvement over the prior year. Inventories fell 10% to $53.5 million, and the company expects to continue generating cash in Q4, traditionally its strongest cash flow quarter.

Q : What is the status of the new product pipeline and its role in reviving wholesale? A : The CEO said Purple has the fullest innovation pipeline in its history, with new Essentials and Hybrid collections representing almost 90% of mattress unit volume. The new Essentials collection launched on e-commerce in early November with a broader market launch around March, while the new Hybrid line replaces Restore and begins rolling into Purple stores in Q1 and shipping to wholesale in March. Both collections will be showcased at the Las Vegas market in January, with early retailer feedback described as very strong.

Q : What cost actions are underway to offset lower volumes? A : The CEO said Purple is managing plant costs, adjusting labor to match production volume, and carefully managing inventory and working capital. Supplier diversification is beginning to show benefits, with additional sourcing initiatives expected in the first half of 2027. news.Title: 亞股血洗！韓股開盤即熔斷暴跌8.5％ 日經下殺逾4千點
news.Content:
美股全面重挫，引爆亞股劇烈殺盤，日韓股開盤即跳水，韓股重挫8.53%至4,923.47點，觸發熔斷機制，日股重摔4,013.21點（或6.57%）至57,064.69點。

美國民主黨贏得期中選舉之後，又打算推出超級AI禁令，永久禁止研發或部署超越人類認知、具備潛在失控風險的「人工超級智慧」（ASI），或展現「超級智慧前兆特徵」的系統。違者比照研發核武器之重罪，最高可處20年聯邦監禁，並提議成立內閣級的人工智慧部。

民主黨加大控制人工智慧產業發展的力道，引發恐慌性賣壓，台積電ADR暴跌42.65美元（或10.78%）至353.1美元，費城半導體指數重挫12.25%，標普500指數暴跌4.36%，那斯達克指數下殺5.52%，道瓊工業指數也殺3.44%。

半導體與人工智慧族群成為殺盤重心，輝達與高通重挫逾9%，超微AMD暴跌17.26%，英特爾重挫10.33%，美光暴跌17.46%，科技巨頭Meta下跌3.96%，亞馬遜摔2.19%，蘋果與谷歌分別跌1.53%與1.94%，特斯拉也跌10.77%。

CNBC報導，針對人工智慧產業的威脅，資產管理機構Janus Henderson投資組合經理Richard Clode坦言，肯定會有倉促的反應，導致一些延誤，這令人擔憂，不幸的是，我們短期內無法找到解決辦法。

投資者不再只關注財報與財測數字，而是放大質疑人工智慧產業成長的可持續性，以及人工智慧技術的消費者是否能夠充分利用它，並質疑循環融資、過度投資與現金流轉負，無法兌現鉅額投資的考驗。

news.Title: nLight (LASR) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
news.Content:
nLight (LASR) came out with quarterly earnings of $0.16 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.06 per share. This compares to earnings of $0.08 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items.

This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +166.67%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this laser maker would post earnings of $0.14 per share when it actually produced earnings of $0.15, delivering a surprise of +7.14%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates four times.

nLight, which belongs to the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry, posted revenues of $73.76 million for the quarter ended September 2026, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 8.55%. This compares to year-ago revenues of $66.74 million. The company has topped consensus revenue estimates four times over the last four quarters.

The sustainability of the stock's immediate price movement based on the recently-released numbers and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's commentary on the earnings call.

nLight shares have lost about 12.1% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 12.3%.

What's Next for nLight?

While nLight has underperformed the market so far this year, the question that comes to investors' minds is: what's next for the stock?

There are no easy answers to this key question, but one reliable measure that can help investors address this is the company's earnings outlook. Not only does this include current consensus earnings expectations for the coming quarter(s), but also how these expectations have changed lately.

Empirical research shows a strong correlation between near-term stock movements and trends in earnings estimate revisions. Investors can track such revisions by themselves or rely on a tried-and-tested rating tool like the Zacks Rank, which has an impressive track record of harnessing the power of earnings estimate revisions.

Ahead of this earnings release, the estimate revisions trend for nLight was mixed. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock. So, the shares are expected to perform in line with the market in the near future. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

It will be interesting to see how estimates for the coming quarters and the current fiscal year change in the days ahead. The current consensus EPS estimate is $0.11 on $73.2 million in revenues for the coming quarter and $0.52 on $303.89 million in revenues for the current fiscal year.

Story Continues

Investors should be mindful of the fact that the outlook for the industry can have a material impact on the performance of the stock as well. In terms of the Zacks Industry Rank, Electronics - Semiconductors is currently in the top 30% of the 250 plus Zacks industries. Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperform the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1.

Another stock from the same industry, Marvell Technology (MRVL), has yet to report results for the quarter ended October 2026.

This chipmaker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $1.10 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +44.7%. The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 0.1% higher over the last 30 days to the current level.

Marvell Technology's revenues are expected to be $3.16 billion, up 52.2% from the year-ago quarter.

Balance sheet strength with $1.6 billion liquidity, net leverage down to 2.4x, and a new $500 million share repurchase program authorized.

Negative Points

Gross margin faces near-term headwinds from lower-margin chemistry equipment mix and capacity expansion costs, expected to persist into 2027.

Chemistry equipment capacity is sold out through 2027, constraining revenue growth until the Guangzhou expansion comes online in Q3 2027.

Potential supply chain constraints from third-party suppliers could impact customer tool deliveries and indirectly affect MKS.

Pockets of inflation are emerging, which could pressure costs and pricing negotiations.

Specialty industrial revenue is expected to remain flat in Q4 after strong growth, with automotive production soft.

Q & A Highlights

Q : Can you give more color on the visibility that semiconductor customers are giving you today, and your latest thoughts on MKS' ability to outgrow WFE through 2027? A : CEO John Lee said the company is in constant contact with all semi customers, who are giving much better visibility than in the past, extending into the 2028 timeframe, though those are guidance levels while actual bookings are shorter-dated. He noted MKS has always outperformed WFE during up cycles, and with the current guidance the company will likely grow about 40% year-over-year versus WFE in the mid-30s percent range, a trend he expects to continue in 2027.

Q : With chemistry equipment sold out through 2027 and bookings extending into 2028, how should we frame the cadence of E&P growth next year, and how does the larger consumable base allow chemistry revenue to grow faster than equipment revenue? A : CEO John Lee said chemistry equipment revenue is likely to reach the $300 million range in 2026 versus a historic peak that never exceeded $200 million, achieved without new factories by squeezing capacity from existing sites and supply chain partners. The Guangzhou expansion, targeted for Q3 2027, will double equipment capacity and should let revenue growth accelerate in the second half of 2027. Chemistry revenue typically follows 20 to 30 months after a PO, including 6 to 8 months to build, plus installation, qualification and ramp, and that chemistry revenue is now beginning to appear and should accelerate in 2027.

Q : Can you walk us through the gross margin puts and takes for next year, given mix and capacity headwinds but rising volumes and chemistry? A : CFO Ramakumar Mayampurath said gross margins improved sequentially and year-over-year and the company remains within its stated 4% to 7% plus incremental framework, with two headwindscapacity and capability investments and the fast-growing equipment mixmasking underlying performance in the near term. Those headwinds are expected to become tailwinds longer term as chemistry consumables grow on the newly installed base and new capacity reaches full utilization. He expects margins to stay at current levels near term, with a path to higher gross margins to be detailed at the December Investor Day.

Q : You called out NAND upgrade spending and seem to have raised your outlook on greenfield NAND spending for 2027. What signals are you seeing and how do you expect that to grow over the next couple of years? A : CEO John Lee said the NAND upgrade cycle is in full swing and one of MKS' biggest customers has said it has been pulled in, with related RPO visible. Publicly announced greenfields are coming online in late 2027 to early 2028, with equipment going in somewhat before that, so upgrades should continue for most of the period before greenfields take off in the latter half of 2027 and into 2028. He called NAND equipment building a multiyear tailwind supporting AI infrastructure.

Q : Are you seeing supply chain constraints, and are there share gain opportunities arising from them, particularly in MFCs and rigid PCB drilling where a Japanese competitor is constrained? A : CEO John Lee said reported shortfalls in certain commoditiessome of which MKS also makesrepresent share gain opportunities, and the operations team has been delivering well while expanding factories toward support for $300 billion WFE. He noted the supply chain feat of asking thousands of suppliers to double and double again, with the industry potentially adding $50 billion of WFE in a single year. On MFCs and rigid PCB drilling, he confirmed these are share gain opportunities, noting rigid PCB drilling strength that will accelerate through 2027 partly because MKS is already qualified.

Q : How much of the chemistry growth is coming from legacy installed equipment versus the equipment shipped over the last several quarters? A : CEO John Lee clarified that Q3 chemistry revenue grew about 26% year-over-year organically, and very little of that came from chemistry tied to new equipmentthat contribution is just starting. The vast majority of chemistry growth came from equipment already installed in the field, and he expects the new-equipment chemistry percentage to grow over time, supporting continued strong chemistry growth rates.

Q : At what point could E&P become an overbuild situation, and what signs are you watching as you look into 2027? A : CEO John Lee acknowledged capacity is faster to add on the E&P side than in semi, but said the key signsdata centers being built are being turned on, and the people building them are making moneyremain intact. He noted MKS has operated in semiconductors for 65 to 75 years and has a long history of reacting quickly to cycle changes, and that CapEx intensity remains low at 3% to 5% even while building both a semi fab and a chemistry equipment fab, keeping financial risk relatively small.

Q : Given visibility out to 2028 and WFE approaching $300 billion, do you expect semi and E&P growth to track similar ranges going forward? A : CEO John Lee said semi growth took a couple of quarters to rev up relative to WFE, with Q3 the quarter MKS began materially exceeding WFE as the supply chain ramped. He said the engine is now humming and the company expects to continue accelerating and overperforming WFE by a large factor for the next several quarters, if not a year or two, based on customer feedback, with any flattening still far away.

Q : Are you seeing ASP tailwinds or contemplating price increases in equipment or chemistries given tight conditions and inflation? A : CFO Ramakumar Mayampurath said there are pockets of inflation, though not widespread so far, and MKS always balances cost and price with cost as a reference point for pricing decisions; increases could come in the second half and into 2027. CEO John Lee added that MKS always tries to capture value for the technology it brings, and the current environment of greater need for that technology supports accelerating value-based pricing.

Q : Can you quantify the E&P tools business coming from rigid PCB applications, and how big the rigid opportunity can get in 2027 and 2028?
